name: Rafi
description:
Rafi is a lively, happy boy with a cheeky personality. Rafi is still just a young boy who is in need of a stable and loving home. He is after a family that is happy to put in a lot of time and effort into his training to help him improve his manners. Dobermans are a breed that need to be worked with for their entire life so we are after someone who is fully committed to taking on this responsibility. Experience with this breed or similar is also a must.

Rafi is going to need a large fully enclosed garden that he can have off lead time in, to burn off energy and to help with his training. Rafi will need plenty of walks and mental stimulation to keep him occupied so he doesn’t cause too much mischief. Rafi would benefit from a home where someone is around a lot and has plenty of free time to focus on him and his training.

Rafi is best suited to an adult only home, with no visiting children.

Rafi needs to be the only dog in the home, no visiting dogs either. Rafi is currently under going socialisation training with dogs to help improve his reactivity. This is something that will need to be continued when he goes home and into the future.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Spud
description:
Spud came into our care through no fault of his own. Despite his age he is still full of energy and loves going for his walks, he walks lovely on a lead. Spud is a typical terrier and can be quite vocal especially when you aren’t paying him attention. We feel that Spud would prefer a home where someone is around most of the day to spend time with him. Spud’s favourite game is fetch, he loves bringing it back and dropping it onto your knee.

Spud has never lived with children before so we think that he would be best to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Spud has said nice hellos to dogs out on his walks but doesn’t seem too fussed by them, he could potentially live with another older dog – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Arlo
description:
Meet Arlo!  Arlo is looking for an active experienced home where he can really thrive.  He is a sweet, friendly and affectionate boy who loves being around people and getting lots of attention.  He has a lovely personality and is a real character, but he is also a very high-energy dog who needs plenty of exercise, mental stimulation and structure in his new home.  Arlo absolutely loves his long walks and enjoys having time off lead in our secure compound, where he can burn off some of that energy.  He is very strong on the lead, so his new owner will need to be confident and experienced with a powerful, energetic dog and willing to continue working on his lead manners.  He also has a fun, mischievous side – Arlo loves to chase the hose pipe when staff are cleaning his kennel, his new adopter will need to continue his impulse control and teach him how to channel his energy and enthusiasm in more appropriate ways.  He is very vocal when he is in his kennel, particularly when he wants attention.  Because of this, we feel he may need gradual introduction to being left alone when he moves into his new home, allowing him time to settle and learn that being alone is safe and okay.  Arlo does know some basic commands, and with the right person, consistency and positive training, there is plenty of potential for him to continue learning.  He will need an experienced owner who understands high-energy dogs and can provide him with lots of exercise, mental stimulation, training, enrichment, scent games and interactive activities. Arlo is not looking for a quiet sedentary lifestyle.  He is an energetic, enthusiastic boy who will need an owner willing to keep his body and mind busy. In return, Arlo has so much affection and fun to give.  He is a lovely boy who deserves a home that understands his needs.  He will need a private secure garden.

Please only apply for this gorgeous boy if you have the time, experience and commitment to work with him.

Arlo has interacted with other dogs whilst in our care, he is very full-on around them and can sometimes be vocal, so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where his new adopter can carry on working on his manners around other dogs in a controlled environment with lots of positive reinforcement.

As Arlo came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children/visiting children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Blue
description:
Meet Blue!  Blue is a beautiful ex-racing greyhound who is now looking for a loving forever home where he can enjoy the life he truly deserves.  Blue is an incredibly sweet, friendly and affectionate boy.  He loves being around people and is happiest when he can be right by your side.  The more fuss and attention he gets, the better! He’s the kind of boy who will happily soak up all the love you have to give.  He walks lovely on a lead and really enjoys his time out and about.  One of his favourite things is chasing around our compound with his beloved squeaky toys – watching him play and have fun is such a joy!  As Blue has never lived in a home before, his new family will need to understand that there will be a period of adjustment.  He will need patience, kindness and help with house training as he learns all about home life.  Everything will be new to him, so he’ll need time to settle, learn a new routine and discover how wonderful being a much-loved pet can be.  Blue has so much love to give and deserves a home where he can feel safe, cherished and part of the family. Blue is ready for his next chapter and we would love to see him find the special home he deserves.  He will need a private secure garden where he can safely be off lead to enjoy his zoomies.

Blue has socialised with other dogs whilst in our care.  He can be a little nervous and unsure around them so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where his new adopter can slowly build up his confidence around other dogs at Blue’s pace.

We feel Blue would be best rehomed where any children in the home are 14+ years.

name: Daisy
description:
Meet Daisy! She is a friendly, sweet-natured girl who absolutely loves her cuddles and enjoys being around people.  Daisy has a lovely playful side too and can often be found having a good old run around our secure compound, chasing after her favourite toys and enjoying some classic Greyhound zoomies!  Daisy walks nicely on the lead and is a pleasure to take out.  She also loves being groomed, happily enjoying all the attention and fuss.  Like many ex-racing greyhounds, Daisy has never lived in a home before, so her new adopter will need to give her time, patience and understanding while she learns all about home life.  House training, new routines, household noises and settling into a new environment will all be a completely new experience for her, with kindness, consistency and plenty of reassurance, Daisy can begin to discover just how wonderful life as a much-loved pet can be.  When she gets over excited, Daisy can be a little mouthy, so her new adopter will need to help her learn appropriate ways to express her excitement.  Daisy is a fun-loving, affectionate girl with plenty of personality.  She loves to play, enjoys cuddles and is ready to leave her racing days behind and start the next chapter of her life.  Daisy has so much love and fun to give and is looking forward to finding a special family she can call her own.  Daisy will need a private secure garden so she can safely have off lead time.

Daisy has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, so we feel she could potentially live with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Daisy can be a little nippy when she is over excited we would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Todd
description:
This handsome boy is Todd!  Todd is a sweet, friendly and very lively boy with plenty of energy to spare!  He is a typical hound in many ways – full of enthusiasm, curious about the world around him and always ready for his next adventure.  He absolutely loves his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can stretch his legs, explore, have a sniff and have fun with his favourite toys.  Watching Todd enjoy himself is a real pleasure! As you would expect from a Fox Hound, Todd is high-energy and needs a very active home that can provide him with plenty of daily exercise.  Walks alone may not be enough to keep his body and mind satisfied, so he would really benefit from additional activities such as scent work, tracking games, enrichment and other opportunities to use his wonderful Hound brain.  Todd is also a vocal boy – hounds are known for their voices, and Todd is certainly not shy about using his!  His new family will need to appreciate that hound singing, baying and general commentary are part of the package.  Hounds are also known for being escape artists so he will need secure, hound-proof fencing and careful management, particularly when he is outdoors. A home that understands the determination and curiosity of a scent-driven hound would be ideal.  Todd has so much character and has all the makings of a fantastic companion in the right home.  He needs someone who understands that a Fox Hound is a lifestyle, not just a pet – but for the right home, Todd will bring plenty of fun, affection and adventure.

Todd has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful and full-on.  We do feel he could potentially live with another dog of similar energy levels that would tolerate his play style following a successful meet and greet.

As Todd came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Nelly
description:
Nelly came into our care through no fault of her own. She has previously lived in a home so we can provide a little more information about what she was like. Nelly is a confident and friendly girl when meeting new people. She enjoys going for her walks with the volunteers, she is a little overweight so can struggle going too far. Her new family needs to be committed to getting her back to a healthy weight. She loves to play with toys so would love a family that has plenty of time to spend with her.

Nelly would benefit from a home that has breed experience. She has previously lived with children, so she can be rehomed with children who are 12 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Nelly is a typical Bulldog and prefers her own space, so we think that she is best suited to being the only dog in the home.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Shadow
description:
Shadow is a very affectionate boy who has been super friendly to our staff and volunteers since he came in to our care. With him being an ex racer, he does have a high prey drive so can try to chase squirrels whilst out for his walks! He absolutely loves chasing his toys around our secure compound.  He is a really affectionate boy who loves lots of fuss and attention.

Shadow will have spent most of his life in kennels with his racing background, so he may feel a little nervous going in to a home environment. We also do not know if he is house trained or toilet trained due to this. He loves to lie in his comfy beds after his walks – we sometimes catch him upside down showing his belly off!

Shadow has now been in our care for 237 days and is desperately searching for his forever home.

We think Shadow would prefer to be the only dog in the home as he can sometimes be a little unsure around them and isn’t too interested in interacting with them.

He could also potentially live with children 14+ years  – subject to a successful meet.

Shadow would love a home where he could relax and enjoy his retirement years and rest on a comfy bed (or couch) of his own!

name: Oscar
description:
Meet Oscar! He is a lovely boy with a huge personality and plenty of puppyish energy!  Oscar is a very lively, energetic and friendly boy who is always ready for his next adventure.  He is a big puppy at heart – giddy, playful and full of enthusiasm and he loves being around people.  Oscar can be quite an excitable boy and does jump up, particularly when he is happy or excited.  He is also very vocal, so his new family should be prepared for a dog who likes to make his presence known!  Oscar has a very playful side.  When staff are cleaning his kennel, he thinks the hose pipe and brushes are fantastic toys and will chase them around.  His enthusiasm can sometimes get the better of him, so he will need patient guidance to learn more appropriate ways to channel his energy.  On walks, Oscar does pull on the lead and will need continued training to help him develop his loose-lead walking skills.  He would really benefit from an owner who enjoys training and can provide consistent positive reinforcement.  Oscar is looking for an active home where he can enjoy plenty of exercise, enrichment and mental stimulation.  He is not a couch-potato kind of boy!  His ideal family will enjoy getting out and about with him and be prepared to give him the time and training he needs to mature into a well-mannered adult.  His new adopter should be willing to work on his impulse control, socialisation and general training.  As a young Lurcher, Oscar will need patience, consistency and plenty of appropriate outlets for his energy.  Underneath all that excitement is a loveable, friendly and very giddy young boy who is still learning about the world.  He will need a private secure garden.

Oscar has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful.  We do feel he could potentially be rehomed with another lively and energetic dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Oscar came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Rudy
description:
Meet Rudy!  Don’t let his age fool you, this lively, energetic boy has plenty of energy and enthusiasm. Rudy is a friendly, excitable and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and fuss.  He has a big personality and is not shy about letting you know when he wants you to interact with him!  Rudy can be quite vocal when he wants your attention or, more importantly, when he thinks it’s time for you to throw his ball.  One of Rudy’s favourite things is chasing his toys, and he could happily spend plenty of time playing and having fun.  He also enjoys his long walks and would love an active home who can provide him with plenty of exercise and opportunities to explore.  Rudy is a strong boy on the lead, so his new adopters will need to be confident handling him and willing to continue on his lead manners.  He does know his basic commands and, with the right guidance, could continue to build on these.  Rudy is looking for an active home where he can enjoy lots of walks, playtime and mental stimulation.  He would suit someone who enjoys getting out and about and is looking for a fun, lively companion with a larger-than-life personality.  Rudy will need a private secure garden.

Rudy has interacted well with other dogs whilst in our care, so we feel he could potentially be rehomed with another lively dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Rudy came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Prince
description:
Prince came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much history on him. We do believe that he could have potentially lived in a home previously and that he isn’t from a racing background. Prince is a happy excitable boy that jumps up in the kennel when you go into him. He can get very giddy for his walks and loves to be outside taking in all of the different smells. Prince has enjoyed different kinds of enrichment in between his walks. He is a sweet boy who is after a loving forever home.

Prince would be best suited to a home with children who are 16 years and over due to his bouncy nature – subject to a successful meet.

Prince can walk near dogs but is a little unsure when they get too close so we believe that he is best suited to being the only dog in the home. Prince will need a family that is happy to work on his socialisation training.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Mayo
description:
Mayo was quite shy and reserved when she first arrived as a stray and would spend her time in her bed. With patience and love she has come out of her shell and her true happy personality is showing. She is now a very excitable girl who loves to greet everyone she meets.

Mayo is a still a young dog that is after a family that is happy to put in the training and work she needs to become a great companion. She is going to need an active home and an enclosed garden so that she has plenty of opportunities to burn off all of her energy. Due to her being nervous her potential adopters may need to have multiple meets to ensure she is comfortable before going home.

We believe that it is best for any children in the house to be over 12 years of age and dog savvy. This would also be subject to a successful meet.

Mayo can be a little nervous around boisterous dogs, but we believe that she can potentially be rehomed with a dog that is calm and willing to help her settle – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Tim
description:
Tim is a typical cheeky Frenchie. He was a little quiet when he first came into our care as a stray, but day by day he is becoming more confident and his cheeky personality is coming out. We have no history on his with him being a stray so a family that has Frenchie experience would be beneficial. Tim walks nicely on his lead and enjoys his walks around our wooded area.

Tim has interreacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so could potentially be rehomed with another dog that has a similar temperament – Subject to a successful meet.

With us not knowing much about Tim yet, we feel that it would best for him to be in an adult only home.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Robbie
description:
Robbie is a very excitable and giddy boy who loves everyone he meets. He can get excited and jump up for a fuss when you go into his kennel. His cheeky personality is coming out each day as he is getting more and more confident. Robbie loves having off lead time in the compound where he can zoom around, he would be best suited to a home with an enclosed garden so he can spend lots of time playing. Robbie came in as a stray so we don’t have any history on him, therefore he could possibly have never lived in a home before. We feel that some experience with dogs would be beneficial for Robbie.

Robbie can be rehomed with children who are 16 + due to his bouncy nature – Subject to a successful meet.

Robbie loves to greet other dogs so could potentially be rehomed with another dog, who also has high energy levels and would want to play – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Swan
description:
Swan came into our care as a stray, meaning we don’t have any previous history on her. She is a very friendly and affection girl, who loves nothing more than a good cuddle with you. As Swan is still young, she would be best suited to an active home able to give her the regular exercise that she requires. Swan thoroughly enjoys playing in our enclosed area where she loves playing and chasing tennis balls.

At times Swan can be a little boisterous and fully on when she gets all excited to see you. We believe she would be best suited to a home with children no younger than 16 years old – subject to a successful meet.

During her time with us, Swan has shown to a social towards other dogs, although at times can be a little over the top and vocal, which is typical of her breed. We do think she would prefer to be only dog in the home, where she can happily play with her own toys and not share her space.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Pumpkin
description:
Pumpkin came into our care as a stray, at first she was unsure and a little worried, but with time and patience Pumpkin has well and truly come out of her shell. Her big beautiful personality is shining through and she has become a lovely confident girl. Pumpkin enjoys meeting new people and adores a good cuddle. She likes going out on her walks as well as a good run around in our enclosed exercise area – she can at times be very strong when walking on a lead.

When Pumpkin first arrived, she was carrying a little extra weight, but with a little love, a healthy diet and plenty of care, she has made fantastic progress. She has worked hard to lose the weight she needed to be ready for adoption, and we couldn’t be happier with her transformation. Her new family will need to continue supporting her healthy lifestyle, helping her stay happy, healthy and thriving in her forever home!

We do believe she would be best suited to an adult only home, where she can also be the only dog, as she would prefer to have her own space. Pumpkin does still like socialising with other dogs and does enjoy saying hello whilst out on her walks.

Pumpkin wouldn’t be suitable to live with a cat or any other small animal.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Otis
description:
When Otis arrived in our care he was very nervous and shy, he can be unsure of being touched, especially by new people. With a lot of patience and love he is slowly starting to trust the staff and volunteers at the center. He is a typical hyperactive terrier who is going to need plenty of walks and mental stimulation to help keep him occupied.

Once he gets to know you he is an affectionate boy. His new family will need to have plenty of time to come and meet him before going home so he can build up his confidence. He just needs someone that is patient and willing to put in the work to gain his trust. Experience with rescue dogs or the breed is needed.

Otis is best suited to an adult only home, with no visiting children.

Otis can walk nicely near dogs but does become a little nervous so we believe he would be best suited to being the only dog in the home. His new family will need to be able to provide training to help him overcome his nervousness.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Nyla
description:
This friendly girl came into our care as a stray and is now looking for a patient, experienced home where she can continue to grow and learn. She absolutely loves meeting new people and is very affectionate. She does have her crazy moments where the Staffie personality comes out in her. She is a strong girl on the lead so her potential owners need to be able to have full control over her. She can be reactive towards other dogs, so she will need continuous and positive training to help her manage this.  It would be beneficial if her new owners have had reactive dogs before so they are equipped to providing her with the training that she needs.

Nyla is after a patient home that understands the commitment involved in taking on a reactive dog. Her new family will need to be prepared to put in plenty of time, effort and training. With structure and stability Nyla has the potential to become a loving companion.

Nyla needs to be rehomed with d0g savvy children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Hugo
description:
Hugo was found as a stray so we don’t have any background information about him. He has been a happy boy from the moment he arrived and loves all of the staff here. He is an extremely excitable and energetic boy with a big personality! He can be quite a handful pulling on his lead when he is out and about on walks, so will need a family that has the time and patience to help him work on his basic obedience and lead training. He will need an active home that can provide plenty of exercise, mental stimulation and enrichment to give him ways to express his enthusiasm. Hugo loves being off lead in our enclosed compound area zooming around and playing with toys.

He is taller than either of the breeds typically are, making him more of a medium sized dog. This should be taken into consideration before applying.

Hugo has interacted well with staff whilst in our care but due to his energy levels we believe it would be best for Hugo to be rehomed to an adult only home.

Hugo has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we believe that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and temperament – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Hero
description:
Hero is an ex racing greyhound who is now looking for his forever home with a family that can help him settle into life beyond the kennels. He is a confident, lively boy with plenty of personality. He gets very excited when it’s time for a walk and can jump around on the lead, so will need someone who is comfortable handling a tall strong greyhound. With a little training and consistency this is something that can be worked on. Although he is confident in many ways, he does need help building his confidence when it comes to being touched and handled as he can get a little worried.  Hero deserves the chance to learn, grow and discover just how good life can be outside of kennels.

Hero can be rehomed with mature children who are 16 years and over, due to his size and bouncy nature. This will be subject to a successful meet.

Hero is currently paired with another greyhound and has interreacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so we believe that he would be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet and greet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Bruce
description:
Meet gorgeous Bruce!  Bruce has had a very difficult start in life.  When he first came into our care, he was in a truly sorry state.  He was extremely thin, and his skin was in a terrible condition.  His body was bald, red and very inflamed, and it was clear that he had not had the care he desperately needed.  After lots of veterinary visits, treatment, time and plenty of TLC, we are so pleased to see the changes in him.  His fur is beginning to grow back, he is gaining weight, and he is slowly starting to feel better in himself.  Bruce is a very frightened and timid boy.  The world is a scary place for him, and he can be extremely nervous and shut down.  He will need someone who understands that building his confidence will not happen overnight.  However, once Bruce learns to trust you, you see a completely different side to him.  He is a very affectionate, playful and loving boy who enjoys being close to the people he feels safe with.  Bruce will need lots of time, patience, understanding and reassurance.  His new adopter must be prepared to give him the space he needs and allow him to progress at his own pace.  This could take some considerable time, and there may be setbacks along the way.  He is looking for an experienced owner who has previous experience with very nervous and fearful dogs and understands the commitment involved in helping a dog like Bruce learn that the world can be a safe place.  Bruce has already come such a long way, and we believe there is a wonderful, affectionate boy waiting to emerge as his confidence grows.  He deserves a quiet, patient and loving home where he can finally feel safe, secure and cherished.  The potential adopter must commit to multiple regular meet and greets for Bruce to get to know then before the adoption can take place.  He will need a private secure garden.

Bruce has socialised with other dogs whilst in our care, he can be ok with some and very unsure around others, so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can get 100% of the love and attention.

As Bruce is so timid we would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Maggie
description:
Meet Maggie!  Maggie is a friendly, affectionate girl who absolutely loves being around people.  She enjoys nothing more than a good fuss and, if you’re offering belly scratches she’ll be your best friend!  Maggie has recently had BOAS surgery with us and has recovered brilliantly,  She is already feeling much better, and it’s wonderful to see her enjoying life with improved comfort and breathing.  She is now ready to find a loving family who will continue to give her all the care, attention and affection she deserves.  Maggie is a gorgeous girl with plenty of love to give, and we’re looking forward to seeing her find the special home she has been waiting for.

Maggie has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, so we feel following a successful meet and greet she could potentially live with another dog of similar size.

As Maggie came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Shep
description:
Shep is an older boy who is looking for a calm retirement home. Shep is an affectionate boy who roles over for belly rubs and paws at you for attention. He does have unusual eyes but that just adds to his charm. Shep needs a home with a family that has previous experience with herding breeds.

Shep needs an adult only home so that he can spend his golden years relaxing in a calm environment.

Shep can be a little unsure around certain dogs, usually big and boisterous dogs, but can interact well with smaller calm dogs. Due to this we feel that it would be best for Shep to be the only dog in the home. Shep would benefit from socialisation training to help his confidence.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a very nervous boy when he meets new people for the first time. It takes a little while for him to come around but with patience and yummy treats he slowly starts to trust you. Once he has gained your trust and is comfortable he is an affectionate boy and loves to give out kisses. He will need to have multiple regular meets before going home.

Bear is a big dog who doesn’t understand his size, he is constantly jumping up for cuddles and doesn’t know what personal space is. Bear is going to require a lot of training to help him learn manners. He can be a very cheeky boy at times! He will need socialising in different environments and around people to help him build his confidence up. Bear gets super excited when going for walks and is very strong on the lead, this is another area that will need more training. Bear loves playing with his toys, splashing around in water and zooming around our enclosed area.

Bear is after an adult only home that has previous experience with big boisterous dogs. No regular visiting children either please. He is going to need a very active home with a family that is able to provide him with plenty of exercise and mental stimulation to keep him busy. As he is still only a young dog he can get up to mischief when he is bored. Bear’s new family need to be committed to putting in the training that he needs not only initially but keeping it up for the rest of his life.

Bear needs to be the only dog in the home so that he can have all of attention to help get him settled. Bear can interact well with dogs whilst out on walks but will need further training to help improve this.

We know that Bear is going to require a lot of work at first but once he is trained he will make a lovely family dog who will love going on plenty of adventures. Taking on a dog this size is a big commitment, please ensure that you are serious and have thought about the future before applying.

name: Freddie
description:
Despite his age Freddie is still full of life and ready to go on lots of adventures with his new family. He loves being out and about exploring and having plenty of sniffs. Once he’s been out for a walk and had a play he is more than happy to curl up in his bed, or preferably your lap and snooze the afternoon away. He is a very loveable and cuddly dog so needs a family that can spoil him and provide him a loving home he deserves.

Freddie needs to be in an adult only home so that he can have his own space to relax.

Freddie is a typical little dog and doesn’t like dogs being in his personal space, he needs to be the only dog in the house. He would benefit from further socialisation around dogs.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Gordon
description:
This handsome boy is Gordon!  He is looking for a loving, quiet home to enjoy his retirement.  Gordon can be a little nervous when he first meets you, but give him a little time and patience and you’ll soon see his sweet personality shine through.  Once he’s settled, he is a friendly, affectionate and lovely boy.  One thing Gordon certainly isn’t shy about is letting you know what he thinks!  In his kennel, he is very vocal and is the loudest boy on the block and definitely has plenty to say.  Once away from the kennel environment, he is much happier and can relax and show you what a sweet boy he really is.  Gordon is also a big fan of his food – winning his heart may well be as simple as offering him a tasty treat!  At 10 years old. Gordon is looking for a quiet retirement home where he can take life at a slower pace, feel safe and secure, and be surrounded by people who will give him the love he deserves.  If you’re looking for a sweet older gentleman with a big voice, an even bigger appetite and a lovely personality waiting to come out, Gordon could be the boy for you.

Gordon has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, but can be possessive of his treats so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Gordon came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Ell
description:
Meet Ell!  She is looking for a loving home where she can continue to build her confidence.  When you first meet Ell, she can be very nervous and timid.  New people and unfamiliar situations can be overwhelming for her, but once she knows and trusts you, her sweet personality begins to shine.  She simply needs an experienced, patient owner who will give her time and space to settle at her own pace.  Once she’s comfortable, Ell is incredibly friendly and affectionate.  She loves belly rubs and enjoys lots of fuss.  She’s not particularly interested in toys, but she does love exploring the world and having a good sniff on walks.  In kennels, Ell can be very vocal, so she will need understanding neighbours and owners who appreciate that she may bark at first but this is just her way of expressing herself.  She can sometimes be a bit growly when she’s at the vets, but this is fear-related, and she benefits from calm, gentle handling during stressful situations.  Ell is currently carrying a little extra weight, so her new adopter will need to help her on a healthy weight-loss journey with sensible exercise and a balanced diet.  This will help improve her overall health and wellbeing.  Ell is looking for a kind, patient home that will see past her initial nerves and give her the chance to blossom. She would benefit from a private secure garden.

Ell has socialised with other dogs whilst in our care, she can be a bit barky around them so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where she can continue to learn her manners around other dogs in a controlled environment with lots of positive reinforcement. This barking behaviour has only started over the last couple of weeks so it could be frustrations of being in a kennel environment.

As Ell came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on her and as she can be a little nervous we would like any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Ripley
description:
Meet Ripley!! He is a gorgeous boy looking for an active, committed home where he can continue to learn and thrive.  He’s a friendly, affectionate boy with a fun-loving personality and is always ready for a game with his favourite toys.  He is full of energy and loves to play, so he will need an active family who can provide plenty of exercise, enrichment, and ongoing training.  Like many young dogs, he can become a little mouthy and nippy when he’s excited, so he will benefit from patient guidance and positive reinforcement to help him learn appropriate manners.  He is still working on his basic commands and will need someone willing to continue his training.  He can also occasionally rag his lead, so further lead training will be important.  Previous experience with Shar-pei’s would be a real advantage, as they can have their own unique characteristics and training needs.  He currently has a cherry eye, which will be surgically repaired before he goes to his new home, so he’ll be ready to start his next chapter feeling his best.  If you’re looking for a playful, lively young dog and have to time and commitment to help him become the wonderful companion we know he can be, Ripley could be the boy for you.

Ripley has socialised well with other dogs and is very playful with them.  He can sometimes get frustrated and bark if he can’t get to them straight away.  We feel he could potentially be rehomed with another playful dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Ripley came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him and as he can be a little nippy when over-excited we would like any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Arlo
description:
Meet Arlo! Arlo is a gorgeous, sweet-natured boy who is very friendly and absolutely loves lots of fuss.  He’s a real people dog and enjoys getting plenty of attention and affection.  He is a very energetic and boisterous lad who can get extremely giddy when he’s excited.  He sometimes forgets just how big he is and will jump up to say hello, so he would benefit from some basic training to help him learn his manners and channel all that enthusiasm.  Arlo recently had a bath, and although he was a little nervous to begin with, he was a very good boy.  Once it was all over, he celebrated in true Arlo style with a case of the zoomies!  He also has a funny habit of rearranging his bed and moving it to wherever he thinks it should be.  Arlo is a loveable, fun, lively character with bags of personality.  He would thrive in a very active home with someone who can give him plenty of exercise, long walks and consistency with his training.  He would need a private secure garden so he can practice his zoomies!

Arlo has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful, so we feel following a successful meet and greet he could live with another dog of similar size and energy level.

As Arlo came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Nibbles
description:
Nibbles is a young boy who is full of energy and has a lot of love to give. Nibbles loves being off lead in our enclosed area running around chasing tennis balls. He has a lot of energy so will need a very active home with a family who can take him out on lots of adventures to burn off his energy. He would benefit from mental stimulation in between walks to keep his brain stimulated. Due to being a young dog Nibbles will need further training to help him grow up to be a well mannered boy, he can be a little nippy at times too.

Nibbles came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on him. Due to being very friendly we think that he can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and older – subject to a successful meet.

Nibbles is friendly with every dog he meets and always wants to play. He can potentially be rehomed with another dog that can tolerate his high energy and playfulness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Lyra
description:
Meet Lyra!  This beautiful girl is looking for an active, experienced home where she can thrive.  She is a lovely, sweet-natured girl with a very giddy and playful personality.  Lyra absolutely loves attention and fuss and is always happy to be involved in whatever is going on.  She has lots of enthusiasm for life and certainly isn’t shy about showing it! Lyra can jump up quite a lot when she gets excited, so this is something her new adopter will need to be prepared to work on.  She is also very strong on the lead and will need someone confident and capable of handling her while they continue training.  As you would expect from a Malinois, Lyra is an active, energetic dog who will need plenty of physical exercise, mental stimulation and ongoing training and socialisation.  Due to the needs and characteristics of the breed previous knowledge and experience of the breed or similar high-drive working breeds is required. Underneath all that energy is an incredibly sweet girl who loves affection and companionship. She will need a private secure garden.

Lyra has socialised well with other dogs, and is very giddy and playful with them.  We do feel she could potentially live with another dog of similar size and energy levels following a successful meet and greet. (must be neutered).

As she came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Elias
description:
Elias is a very sweet and friendly boy. He came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on him. He has always been friendly with staff and volunteers whilst here. Elias can be a little strong on the lead due to his size so some basic lead training would be beneficial for him. We are looking for an active home for Elias as he has a lot of energy and would enjoy going on lots of adventures. Elias is a calm boy in his kennel and loves to have some down time with a tasty chew.

Elias is a friendly boy but due to his size we believe that it would be best for him to be rehomed with children over 14 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Elias needs a little more training around dogs since his castration as he has become a little unsure, therefore we believe that Elias would benefit from being the only dog in the home as he would prefer all the attention on him.

name: Dakota
description:
Dakota is looking for her forever home, and she has so much love to give.  She’s an incredibly sweet, friendly girl who absolutely adores people.  If you’re happy to give her plenty of fuss, she’ll be in her element!  Despite her size, she is a gentle soul with a lovely nature and enjoys spending time with her favourite humans.  She already knows some basic commands and is very eager to please so would benefit from further training.  Being a young, strong dog, she can be powerful on the lead, so her new adopter will need to be confident and committed to continue her lead training.  Because of this, she will be best suited to an active home where she can enjoy plenty of exercise, adventures and mental stimulation.  If you are looking for a loyal, affectionate companion with a heart as big as she is, this lovely girl could be the one for you.  She will need a private secure garden.

She has socialised with other dogs whilst in our care, and is very playful and can be too much for other dogs as she does get in their face so for this reason we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where she can continue to learn manners and boundaries around other dogs will the full support of her new adopter with lots of positive reinforcement.

As Dakota came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Jax
description:
This stunning boy is Jax! we are looking for an experienced home for this fantastic lad.  He is a friendly and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and enjoys a good fuss.  He has a wonderful nature and is always happy to spend time with his people. This clever lad is exceptionally well behaved at the vets, taking examinations and handling in his stride, which is a testament to his temperament and trainability.  Like many dogs, he has his own little quirks – one of his favourites is enthusiastically ragging his blankets and rearranging them to his liking!  As a typical Belgian Malinois, he is highly intelligent, energetic and thrives on both physical exercise and mental stimulation.  He loves charging around our compound and would be happiest in a home where he has plenty of opportunities to stay active and engaged.  Because of his breed traits, he will need an owner who has previous experience with Belgian Malinois and understands their needs.  He is not a dog that will be content with a short walk around the block, he requires ongoing training, enrichment and a lifestyle that allows him to use both his body and brain.  He will need a private secure garden.

Jax was rehomed but sadly has been returned to us as his prey drive was too much for his new owners. He cannot be rehomed with cats or small furries.  He will need an owner that has previous experience with large breed high prey dogs.

He has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, so we feel he could possibly be rehomed with another dog (similar size) following a successful meet and greet.

As Jax came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Cali
description:
Cali was a very nervous girl when she first arrived at the home, which was over 200 days now! It has taken a lot of time for staff and volunteers to get to know Cali and bring out her excitable, bubbly personality. Cali loves going for walks and off lead runs in our compound area, she will always be found with a football in her mouth. She loves to dodge past you whilst you try and catch her, her tail never stops wagging. Cali loves her treats and sits nicely whilst you give them to her. She has been toilet trained whilst in our care, which is a bonus for when she goes home.

Cali can be strong on the lead at times due to her excitement to get outside and enjoy the fresh air but can walk nicely after her initial excitement is over, especially on a harness. Cali would love a fully enclosed garden with someone around most of the time so that she can come and go as she pleases. Cali spends most of her day relaxing on a comfy bed watching people come and go. She can be a little barky in her kennel at first but this is due to her wanting to say hello to everyone.

Cali isn’t a cuddly kind of girl but would love a family that is willing to keep her entertained and will play with her toys. We believe that Cali needs to be in an adult only home, with a family that has experience with rescue dogs or bull breeds.

Cali was nervous of dogs when she first came into our care so we think that it is best that she is the only dog in the house. With a lot of socialisation she now is a friendly girl that is happy to say hello to most dogs that she meets.

We think that it would be best for Cali to not be in a house with cats.

If you think you can give this gorgeous girl her forever home please apply!

name: Willow
description:
This stunning girl is Willow.  Willow was very nervous and unsure for the first few weeks she was with us.  She was very vocal when the staff went in her kennel and would hide in the back.  The staff have worked hard with her to gain her trust and she has come out of her shell now and is showing her playful friendly side.  We are looking for an experienced owner for Willow that have had nervous large breed dogs previously and will work with her on her confidence, doing this at Willow’s pace and not too rushed.  She is a very independent girl who will come to you when she wants some attention, her toys are her number 1 priority in life.  Willow is very food orientated and will sit nicely for her treats.  This said she is a little bit chunky at the moment so is on weight management food to help her loose a few pounds, and well done to Willow and the staff as she has managed to lose 3kg up to now!  She will need continued training and socialisation. Willow will benefit from a private secure garden where she can have off lead time to relax and have a sniff about.

Willow has socialised ok with other dogs whilst in our care but we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home as she does prefer her own space.

As Willow came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on her so would prefer an adult only household.

name: Bruce
description:
Bruce is a very active and playful boy who absolutely loves chasing around our compound with his toys.  He can be quite boisterous and bouncy when he is excited so would definitely benefit from continued training and socialisation. He can be quite a strong boy on his lead too.

He will need an active home where he can get all the exercise and mental stimulation he will need every day. Bruce would benefit from a private secure garden where he can have off lead time with his toys in between his walks.

Bruce has interacted well with most dogs whilst in our care but can be very dominant with them so we feel he would be best suited to be the only dog in the home.  The new adopter will need to continue his socialisation with other dogs to improve his interactions with them.

As Bruce can get nervous and overwhelmed meeting new people, especially men, we feel that it would be best for him to go to an adult only home. He will need time to get to know you before going home. His new family will need to be able to commit to multiple meets.

Bruce is a wonderful, vibrant boy with lots of love to give to his new family! He has spent a while in kennels now so would love to find his forever home and someone to be the person to throw his ball endlessly! Do you think this could be you?

name: George
description:
This happy chappy is George, our 12 year old Patterdale Terrier! His lifelong dream is to find the perfect napping spot, and he’s wondering if he might find it in your home? George would like to be the only dog in the home, as he can be a little selective about his doggy friends; he’s working on his social skills with other dogs here at the centre by taking calm on-lead walks, and he’d love to continue this with his forever family. George could live with older primary school children, as long as everybody is happy to give him some space when he needs it. He has plenty of energy for an older gentleman and he’s pretty spritely, though ideally his new home wouldn’t have too many stairs! George is such a lovely boy and we’re excited to see him thriving with his forever family.

George loves to get out and about for a sniffy walk, especially if there’s a stream he can explore, and he travels well in the car. He prefers to sit in the front seat if he’s allowed! He’s fully housetrained (though he may need a few reminders whilst he gets used to his new home) and once he’s settled in, he could be left by himself for 4-6 hours at a time. George isn’t overly interested in playing with toys – he much prefers to spend quality time curled up on the sofa with his favourite humans. If you’re looking for a loyal cuddly companion, George could be the dog for you!

name: Merle
description:
Merle is a wonderful 14 year old crossbreed who is currently residing in one of our foster homes. Merle is a very sweet boy who has the potential to live with another dog, pending mixes done here at the centre. He also has the potential to live with a cat in the home, pending a successful scent swap. Merle enjoys a fuss and will often climb into your lap for a cuddle. He is a friendly boy who is able to live with primary aged children.

Merle is being a brilliant house guest in his foster home but he cannot wait to find his forever home. Merle does have a heart murmur so is on ongoing medication for this. He is friendly with everyone he meets and will make such a loving addition to a home.

name: Poppy
description:
Poppy is a gorgeous 3 yr old Jack Russell. She is super playful and absolutely loves a game of tug and chase. Poppy can be a little worried at first with new people and places, but she soon comes around and is a sweet, fun, friendly girl who makes wonderful company! Because of her anxiety Poppy will need adopters who are willing to come meet her multiple times so that she can get comfortable with you and show her true playful side! She has Luxating Patella which is something our team and vets will talk through with you, please don’t let this put you off finding out more about Poppy as she really is a lovely girl who could bring so much joy to your life!

Poppy is looking for a quiet and patient home, with people who have the time to help her settle in slowly. At first, she will need to have someone around all the time to help her find her paws, once she’s more settled the aim would be to leave her for short bursts and build this up alongside her confidence! Poppy has made some lovely friendships with her handlers during her stay and has shown a real keenness to learn which is great for training! Like many of us Poppy sometimes needs a little bit of quiet time to herself, which is why she would be best placed with adults only or secondary school children who can understand and give her a safe space to unwind. She may be able to live with other small dogs depending on how dog mixes go.

If you’re looking to give a lovely little dog the chance at starting a new chapter and you’re happy to initially spend lots of time to help her get settled in, we really think you should add gorgeous Poppy to your favourites!

name: Albert
description:
Meet Albert, a beautiful 2 -year old Labrador looking for his forever home! Albert is a lovely boy, who absolutely loves attention! He is very playful, active and eager to have treats. He can be a bit worried meeting new people initially, so would prefer to live with sensible secondary school aged children and over. He does need a bit of work on his social skills, so would prefer to be the only dog in the home, but is happy to make friendly female friends out and about. Albert prefers walks in quieter areas as he can be a bit reactive to other males. Albert will need a bit of confidence building in some areas, but will be a wonderfully affectionate boy to his family. He is fully house-trained, and loves a good bit of cheese or pate when he's being a good boy. This will also be a great aid in any training! Albert is good on lead, though can pull when excited and would love an active family that can take him on fun adventures. He loves to play fetch with his toys and has a real love for tennis balls. We can't wait to see this handsome chappy living it up in his forever home!

Albert is a sweetheart, who can be a bit spooked by sudden movements and noises so would prefer a quieter home environment. He can be a bit wary of males, so will need a bit of support with his confidence in his new home. Albert would prefer for his new family to be home with him for the majority of the time at first, as he doesn't love being left alone. Once comfortable with his people, he is an angel and adores a cuddle. 
He loves to play with toys, though has shown some low level guarding around this and high value treats, so would need management of this in the home and a solid 'drop & swap' to ensure he isn't challenged for any resources in the home. 
Albert is a wonderful young chap with so much potential, and we know he'll make his new family very happy.

name: Renee
description:
Renee is a splendid Staffie who can’t wait to bounce her way into your heart and home! She has been friendly with all the new faces she’s met here. She can be a little over-the-top with her greetings, but as long as the children are happy with her she’ll be fine around kids of around primary school age.  Renee needs to be the only pet in the home. She struggles seeing dogs out and about and will need her new family to support her with this (with our help!). Quiet walking areas would be a good idea, at least at first.

Renee is 4 years old and was found as a stray. She’s really not enjoying kennel life very much and would love to get her fresh start in life soon. We don’t know anything about her history or if she’s been in a home, but she has remained housetrained while in kennels so she might not be starting from scratch. Things like car travel and being left alone will likely need a bit of time and patience though.

name: Allie
description:
Allie is a gentle soul, she has so much love to give and when you are in Allie’s club you’ll never want to leave. Allie is affectionate, clever, sweet and will make someone the perfect companion. Allie would like a quiet home, much like herself, where she can settle in and take life at her pace. Allie would like an adult only home without other pets, but in turn promises to give you all the love you could need!

Allie can be worried by other dogs, whilst she has worked super hard on this she would like a home where she can access quiet walks and adopters willing to continue her training to build her confidence. Allie loves the car and hopping in for a little adventure. She can be left at home but would like some time to settle in before being left a full working day.

name: Winter
description:
Meet gorgeous girl, Winter! Winter is a 1-year old Spaniel X Bulldog looking for her forever home. Winter is a very clever, energetic pup! She will need an active home with plenty of stimulation to keep her busy brain occupied. Winter would like to live with another dog, but can be a bit OTT and boisterous so her new sibling would need to be tolerant. Winter would prefer for all children to be sensible, older secondary school aged and over as she can be mouthy when excited. She is very bouncy, and exhibits boisterous behaviour. 
Winter needs a garden in her new home, where she can spend time playing with her toys and having a good run about. She's a huge fan of tricky enrichment, as this keeps her brain working. Winter is good for handling, and enjoys her long sniffy walks where she can spend some time running around. She is a wonderful girl, and we can't wait to see her in her forever home!

Winter is full of beans, and would love a family that can keep up with her. She loves to go for long walks, and engage in stimulating enrichment. Winter loves meeting new people and doggy friends alike, but may need some guidance with her manners. 
She has been left for up to 4 hours previously, so there is scope for this to happen again once settled in her new environment. Winter loves shredding and ripping up appropriate enrichment, and loves play times with her people. 
Winter will be a wonderful addition to the home, and will bring so much fun and love to her family.

name: Derek
description:
Derek needs a home where he is the only pet in the home but he could live with secondary school aged children. He would need his leaving hours being built gradually but could be left alone 3-4 hours once settled in.

Derek wants nothing more than companionship and cuddles on a sofa. He is not looking for much in life except for plenty of fuss, nice little walking adventures and a full belly.

name: Nelly
description:
The height (or anticipated adult height) of this dog is below the threshold required for a dog to be considered an American Bully XL type.

Meet Nelly our sweet 3 year old American Bulldog. Nelly is a super fun and silly girl who is looking for a reasonably busy home who can keep her clever brain active with ongoing training and enrichment. Nelly can be bouncy when saying hello so is looking to live with children of an older secondary school age who are comfortable around larger dogs. Nelly is very typical of her breed and can be quite boisterous with her play style. For this reason, she could live with another dog who matches her play style, pending a successful meet at our centre. Nelly is a wonderfully affectionate girl who loves spending time with her favourite people and would love to cosy up at your feet whilst you're watching TV in the evenings.

Nelly is a happy, bubbly girl who walks well on lead, enjoys her long sniffy walks and exploring new places. She loves meeting new people and having a fuss, but can get easily overexcited, so would benefit from owners who can help her regulate through training and enrichment. Nelly is a bit undersocialised with other dogs and can sometimes be a bit intense with her playstyle, but she is learning her manners in our care and is mixing well with other dogs. Nelly has learned through positive association to wear her muzzle when mixing with other dogs, to keep her safe. At the end of the day, Nelly loves to cuddle up with her favourite people on the sofa and can't wait to find her forever home.

name: Rocket
description:
This lovely lad is Rocket, a 4-year-old Crossbreed with so much to offer his forever home. Rocket has been working very hard to get ready for his fresh start, and he can’t wait to show you what an amazing boy he is! He will need multiple meets here at the Rehoming Centre prior to adoption so that the training team can offer all the tips and tricks for introducing Rocket to his new life. Rocket is best suited as the only pet, and he will need an active, adult only household that most importantly love to have fun! A secure outdoor space would be amazing for him to run around, play and sniff during the day. His adopters should also be able to be at home with him at the beginning, and until leaving time can be gradually increased.

Rocket loves to spend time with people and is the friendliest, most loving boy. His favourite thing to do is go on adventures, and he will travel in the car to find the best spots. Rocket’s ideal walking location is somewhere quieter, as meeting lots of other dogs is overwhelming for him. However, when he is properly introduced, he can make fantastic dog friends to have play dates with! Rocket has an infectious personality that leaves everyone smiling, his goofy ways and funny antics will make him such a great addition to his new home.
