Lola, a Croatian hunting dog mix, would appreciate a home without little furries to chase. She has no reservations about men or women and can coexist with dog-savvy children aged 16 and above.

Described by her carers as confident, friendly, and comfortable with other dogs and visitors, Lola is a joy to have around. She walks well on a lead and cherishes moments of cuddling.

Currently residing in Croatia, Lola is ready to embark on a new chapter of her life in the UK through Rescue Backup (RBU). Vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, Lola is well-prepared for the journey.

If you’re ready to welcome Lola into your heart and home, an application and checks are part of the process, ensuring a harmonious match between Lola and her future family.

name: Twix
description:
Twix is a small, approximately 1-2-year-old female Cross-Breed currently in Romania, seeking a loving family.

Vaccinated and spayed, Twix is microchipped and ready for adoption.

She was abandoned and found roaming the streets, highlighting her need for a stable and caring home where she will be cherished forever.

Twix is described as friendly and gets along well with both people and other dogs, making her a good fit for a family environment.

She is suitable for children aged 8 and above, indicating she can adapt well to a household with older kids.

In terms of training, Twix will benefit from support with housetraining and ongoing positive reinforcement to help her settle into her new home smoothly.

She has no known allergies or intolerances and does not require any medication at present.

Currently under the care of Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK, Twix’s adoption process will involve an application and necessary checks to ensure she finds a suitable and loving forever home.

name: Kalea
description:
Kalea, a lovely and calm girl, is rescued from a distressing public shelter in Romania.

Approximately 6 years old, Kalea has been thriving in a private foster home for over a year, enjoying the care and attention she deserves.

Walking nicely on a lead, Kalea has adapted well to both female and male caregivers. In good health, she boasts no known allergies or intolerances. She is spayed, vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, ensuring she is ready for her forever home.

In her quest for the perfect home, Kalea is looking for a calm and friendly environment, ideally with individuals who are rescue dog-savvy. She could happily coexist with another dog, and older children aged 14 and above, provided they are dog-savvy as well.

A secure garden is on her wishlist, creating a safe space for her to enjoy.

Kalea thrives in a home that isn’t too bustling with constant comings and goings, seeking a haven that provides love, compassion, and safety. Her potential adopters are urged to be prepared to go above and beyond to meet the needs of a rescue dog.

Recognizing the considerable journey these dogs undertake to find a home, it’s crucial to afford them the time they need to decompress, which may extend to days or even weeks.

The adoption process for Kalea involves an application and checks, ensuring that her potential adopters are committed to providing the care, understanding, and patience required for a dog with a challenging past.

For those ready to open their hearts and homes to Kalea, the reward will be the companionship and gratitude of a soul on its journey to a brighter future.

name: Beau
description:
Beau is a 3.5-year-old male cross-breed. He is a wonderful and calm dog, longing for a home where he can feel loved and secure.

Rescued from a public shelter in Romania, Beau currently resides in a private shelter, where he has shown himself to be a calm and gentle character.

Weighing 18kg, Beau is vaccinated, blood tested, flead, wormed, neutered, and microchipped. His thick coat and beautiful black button nose add to his charm.

Despite his past, Beau interacts well with everyone in the shelter and lives peacefully with two males and a female dog in his kennel.

Beau has met older children, specifically teenagers, and has shown a calm and gentle demeanour around them. He has no allergies or intolerances and does not require any regular medications.

An ideal home for Beau would be one with dog-experienced owners who can provide a secure garden for him to explore. The household should be calm, kind, and patient, with older children aged 14 and above.

Although Beau is calm and gentle, he needs support with lead training, house training, and continued socialising. It is important to note that Beau is not suitable to live with cats.

Beau’s potential new family will need to go through the application and checks process with Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

This ensures that Beau will be placed in a suitable environment where he can thrive and be happy.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is an 8-year-old male Mioritic shepherd cross, measuring 56cm in height, residing in Romania.

Rescued from a public shelter, Milo’s heart longs for a loving home where he can spend his remaining years.

Despite his size, he possesses a gentle heart and hopes to find someone special to share his life with.

Currently staying in a private shelter, Milo awaits the day someone chooses him to be part of their family.

He seeks an experienced home capable of caring for big dogs like him, preferably with knowledge of Mioritic breeds.

Transitioning to a new environment, Milo will need time to decompress and adjust, making patience and kindness essential qualities in his future owners.

A secure garden would be ideal for him to play and explore safely, fulfilling his desire for outdoor activities.

On the medical front, Milo is fully vaccinated, blood tested, and has received flea and worm treatments.

He is also neutered, microchipped, and registered in the Recs system.

Milo is prepared for travel to the U.K. with his own passport and import papers, though he understands the journey will take time.

name: Lucy
description:
Meet Lucy – the sweetest little survivor.

Lucy is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, born in September 2024. One of nine puppies who started life on the streets of Romania, she and her siblings were taken into safety at just a few days old, and brought over to the UK at the end of January.

Now she’s ready to find her forever home.

Lucy has recently been tested and is Brucella canis-free.

Lucy is a gentle, loving girl who adores cuddles and playtime with her brother. She can be a little vocal at strange noises, but she’s improving every day. She thrives in the company of other dogs and would love a home where she has a canine friend.

We’re also told she gets along well with cats!

Lucy would do best in a home with another friendly dog to give her confidence. A family who can offer her patience, love, and plenty of cuddles will be rewarded with a loyal companion.

Lucy is currently in a foster home near Neath, Port Talbot.

name: Ernesto
description:
Ernesto is a beautiful boy 4 years old 25 to 30 kg a Collie cross very friendly with people. He was a few months in a public shelter in Romania before being save to a private shelter over there.

In the public shelter as seen in one of the videos he was with other dogs but in the private shelter he is all alone in his pen (second video) because they feel he doesn’t like other dogs.

Ernesto has a very sad life he’s been 2 years now in the private shelter and never gets out.

Such a frustrating life for this young boy. Is there anyone with experience who can offer Ernesto the life he deserves a fun active life with people who have got lots of time for him as we don’t want him to be lonely any more.

Ernesto is a great boy with so much joy to give. Please change his life. No children. Not cat tested. Ernesto is vaccinated blood tested neutered and microchipped.

He is ready any time to be transported to your home. Adoption fee £450 . A home check is requested. Rescue back up.

name: Tigris
description:
Tigris is a 4-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a large boy with a soft, kind and very friendly nature. Tigris was found in Bucharest at just 3 months old and, sadly, has spent nearly his entire life in a small space at a private shelter in Romania.

Despite his background, he has held onto his gentle character and is a joy to be around.

Tigris loves going for walks, though unfortunately he has not had the chance to enjoy them often. He is very good with other dogs, which makes him an excellent candidate for a multi-dog household.

He has not been tested with cats, so this is still unknown. At present, he is a bit overweight and will benefit from a loving home that can help him lose a few kilos with regular exercise and a good routine.

This boy is neutered, vaccinated, blood tested and microchipped, so he is fully prepared to travel to the UK as soon as a home offer comes his way.

He is best suited to an adult-only home where he won’t be left alone for long stretches of time, as he has already spent far too much of his life in lonely conditions. With someone who has plenty of time and affection to give, Tigris will truly flourish.

Tigris deserves a family that will help him make up for the years lost in a shelter. He will reward his adopters with unwavering loyalty, companionship and love. All he needs is someone to take a chance on him and offer the warm, secure home he has always dreamed of.

name: Buddy
description:
Buddy is a 3 year old male Dachshund cross Collie. He lives in Royston, Hertfordshire, where he is patiently waiting for his forever family to find him.

Buddy is a charmingly odd-looking pup. He’s lively and playful, he enjoys spending time outdoors and loves his daily walks. Buddy does walk very well on a lead but still prefers a collar to a harness.

Buddy is extremely affectionate and attached to the people he trusts; once a person wins his heart, he will be their most loyal, loving friend forever.

Buddy’s full of unconditional love and always ready for a good, long cuddle. At the moment, Buddy is struggling with self-confidence. He is making good progress and already learned to tolerate scary noises like thunder, TV or loud machinery and hardly flinches nowadays.

Buddy is, however, still intimidated by strangers, especially when he’s concerned they are invading his territory. He wants to keep his family safe and whenever strangers approach, he can get vocal to warn them.

Buddy is much more relaxed around women, and given time, he warms to most people. He is often timid around new dogs too and does not like cats.

Buddy is a really sweet, loving boy and we would love to find a family ready to give him all the time and consistent training he needs.

We’re sure he is capable of overcoming his struggles and becoming a more confident pup. Buddy is not neutered yet, as consultations with two vets suggested that it could worsen his fear.

name: Jess
description:
Jess is a 7-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a medium-sized dog weighing 16.6kg and measuring 20cm in height.

With some Shepherd-type traits, Jess has a distinctive appearance and a strong personality to match.

Jess has had a difficult time building confidence, and her anxiety can sometimes lead to behaviours that appear aggressive toward unfamiliar people.

This behaviour stems from fear rather than aggression, and with the right support, she has shown encouraging progress.

She has nipped a few people in the past, but she now wears a muzzle without issue during her walks.

Training has helped her make great strides, and once she builds trust, Jess becomes a deeply affectionate and loving companion.

Jess is searching for a very specific home—rural, quiet, and with plenty of space where she can roam freely without the stress of unfamiliar people.

It’s a rare kind of home, but one she truly deserves.

name: Ruxx Matrixx and Myra
description:
Ruxx Matrixx is a 2.5-year-old female Cross-Breed, and her sister, Myra, is the same age and breed.

Both were tragically found in a bag in Romania as newborn puppies just a few days old. Fortunately, they were rescued and taken into foster care, where they have grown into lovely, friendly dogs.

The sisters have lived together since their rescue and, while they can be adopted separately, it would be wonderful if they could find a home together.

Ruxx Matrixx and Myra are described as exceptionally good-natured dogs, longing for loving homes. They are friendly, sociable, and adaptable.

They can walk well on a lead, which is a testament to their training and temperament. Each dog weighs approximately 20 to 22 kg, making them medium-sized Cross-Breeds.

Both dogs are fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, and blood-tested. They also have valid passports, enabling them to travel directly to their adoptive homes in the UK.

The adoption fee for each dog is £450, and transportation to the adopter’s home is included. A home check will be conducted to ensure a suitable match, and the rescue provides lifetime backup support for both dogs.

These two sisters have had a challenging start to life but are now ready to bring joy and companionship to their new families. They are eager to be part of a loving home where they can finally experience the security and affection they deserve.

name: Raya
description:
Raya is a one-year-old female cross-breed dog, currently residing in a private shelter in Romania.

She exudes a particularly calm, quiet, and obedient nature, longing for a loving home to call her own. Despite her young age, Raya displays remarkable maturity and doesn’t engage in conflicts with her fellow shelter dogs.

She has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and undergone thorough blood testing, ensuring her good health and readiness for adoption.

Raya craves companionship and is seeking a household with someone who can dedicate plenty of time and attention to her.

She is proficient in walking on a lead, showcasing her adaptability and readiness for urban life.

Consider welcoming Raya into your home; she promises to be a delightful companion with her gentle disposition and loving nature. For an adoption fee of £425, you can provide Raya with the forever home she deserves.

A home check is requested to ensure the suitability of the environment for Raya’s well-being, and rescue backup is available for ongoing support.

Raya can be delivered to your doorstep, facilitating the adoption process for potential owners. Don’t miss the opportunity to make Raya a cherished member of your family.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a 2 to 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. Bear currently resides in a shelter in Romania after the tragic passing of his owner. Known as a “diamond dog,” he has earned this nickname because of his exceptionally friendly and gentle nature.

Bear is a social dog who enjoys the company of cats and other dogs, making him an excellent companion in multi-pet households.

He weighs between 20 to 22 kilograms, and he is described as well-behaved and adaptable. Having lived in a home before, he is saddened by his current shelter life and is ready to experience the love and comfort of a family again.

Bear is neutered, vaccinated, and blood-tested. He also comes with a passports, making him fully prepared for international adoption.

He can walk confidently on a lead, making him ideal for adopters who enjoy regular walks. His adoption fee is £400 , which covers all preparations and transport to his new home.

A home check is required to ensure that Bear is placed in a safe and loving environment. His new family will also have rescue backup for additional support. If you’re looking for a loving, loyal companion, Bear is ready to bring warmth and happiness into your home.

name: Prince
description:
Prince Charming is a 3-year-old male Akita. He is currently looking for a new family to love and care for him after arriving at the shelter in November 2024 as a stray. It is puzzling why no one came forward to claim him, as he is a lovely boy with an engaging personality.

Once he settles into his stride, he walks well on the lead, showing that he can be a reliable walking companion. He enjoys the company of other Akitas and appears to be comfortable walking alongside them.

However, Prince can become a bit excitable when he sees smaller dogs during walks, so it is recommended that he be placed in a home with a large breed, spayed female dog, following successful introductions.

His food motivation is a significant advantage in ongoing training, as it helps him learn new commands and behaviours. He already knows how to sit and give a double paw but has plenty of room for improvement and learning.

At the kennels, Prince enjoys running around and is quite energetic, relishing the chance to jog alongside his human companions. He would thrive in an active household where he can partake in daily exercise and enjoy games of chase.

His playful nature is evident when he showcases his Akita zoomies, and he loves to play fetch, although he may not always return the toy.

As Prince is a stray, the shelter is keen to find him a suitable home, ideally without children or with older children aged 12 years and above. This ensures a peaceful environment for Prince, where he can continue to adapt and thrive in his new family.

name: Aspen
description:
Meet Aspen, a 2 year old female Labrador Retriever — the regal Lab girl with a free-spirited heart.

The regal Lab girl with a free-spirited heart. When we first saw her, we couldn’t believe it.Who could abandon a Labrador like Aspen? A dog with no flaw, no “issue,” no reason — only grace, loyalty, and joy.

She stood there in that cold prison kennel… smiling. As if to say: “This is not the end for me.”Aspen is everything a dog parent could dream of:

Positive, stable, affectionate, radiant. She runs with the wind, plays with dogs, rests gently under your legs, and greets each day with that signature Lab smile.

Her name suits her perfectly: Aspen — strong and beautiful like the tree, rooted in nature yet free in spirit. She is a reminder of everything we love about Labradors: their sunshine, their loyalty, their endless capacity for joy.

Aspen is ready — not just to be adopted, but to be cherished.To be that dog who runs by your side, rests at your feet, and fills your life with the love only a Lab can give.

Will you give this elegant black Lab her forever story? Please get in touch to find out how to adopt her today!

name: Chicago
description:
Hi, I’m Chicago — a 3 year old male Jura Hound Cross.

I might not be the kind of dog who runs straight up for cuddles, but I’ve come such a long way, and I’m really proud of how far I’ve come.

Not so long ago, I was abandoned in a killing pound, completely petrified and shut down. It was clear I had never truly known kindness or felt safe around people. I was so scared that I couldn’t even imagine what love or trust could feel like.

Then CYDRA came into my life and rescued me. Slowly, I started to discover that not all humans are bad. Step by step, I’m learning that life can be good.

These days, I’m brave enough to sit quietly while someone puts my lead on, and I even get excited when I know it’s time to go outside — that’s where I feel my happiest. I love running around doing my zoomies, feeling free, and I’ll even come over for treats now.

When I first arrived, though, things were really tough. I was suffering from a severe ear infection that caused me constant pain. Despite months of treatments and efforts by the vets, it just wouldn’t get better.

Eventually, the only option left to give me the pain-free life I deserved was surgery to remove my ear canal. It was a big decision, but it changed my life for the better.

Since the operation, I’ve transformed into a much happier and more confident boy. I’m so much more at ease and genuinely enjoy being outdoors, exploring, and even being around people.

Right now, I’m still on my journey to trust fully. I know there’s a social, playful boy inside me, just waiting for the right family to help him shine. I’ll need time, patience, and lots of understanding, but I promise I’m worth it.

I’m looking for a quiet, countryside home where I can continue to grow at my own pace. I would love to have another calm, confident dog by my side to show me the ropes and help me build even more trust.

If there are children in my future home, they should be over 12 and comfortable giving me the space I sometimes need.

I was bitten by a sandfly and developed leishmania, but don’t worry — it’s dormant and under control thanks to treatment. I just need to take an inexpensive daily medication and have regular blood tests (twice a year) to ensure it stays that way.

My rescuers are very knowledgeable about leishmania and assure me that it’s manageable and won’t shorten my life if monitored properly. Plus, it’s not contagious to humans or other animals.

If you have a big heart, a peaceful home, and the patience to help a boy like me learn what true love and happiness are, I promise I’ll do my very best to become the loyal, joyful companion you’ve been dreaming of.

Could you be the family who helps me find my confidence, my joy, and my forever place in the world?

name: Jako
description:
Jako is a 2-year-old male Croatian Shepherd Cross.

Jako is suitable for living with children over 8 years old and can get along well with other dogs, making him an excellent fit for families with older children and canine companions.

However, he has not been tested with cats, so his compatibility with them is unknown. Jako is a loyal, easily trained, and loving dog.

Although he is not completely house-trained since he currently lives outside with his siblings, he is expected to learn quickly.

Jako is castrated, vaccinated, and microchipped.

His adoption fee is £475, which includes a home check and full rescue backup provided by Ninas Haven, ensuring comprehensive support for his new family.

name: Astra
description:
Astra is a 2-year-old female Croatian Shepherd Cross.

Astra is suitable for living with children over 8 years old and can get along well with other dogs, making her a great addition to families with older children and existing dogs.

However, she has not been tested with cats, so her compatibility with them is unknown. Astra is a loyal, easily trained, and loving dog.

Although she is not completely house-trained since she currently lives outside with her siblings, she is expected to learn quickly.

Astra is castrated, vaccinated, and microchipped.

Her adoption fee is £475, which includes a home check and full rescue backup provided by Ninas Haven, ensuring comprehensive support for her new family.

name: Inka
description:
Inka is a 2-year-old female Croatian Shepherd Cross.

Inka can live with children over 8 years old and gets along well with other dogs, making her a good fit for families with older children and canine companions.

However, she has not been tested with cats, so her compatibility with them is unknown. Inka is a loyal, easily trained, loving, and playful dog.

Although she is not completely house-trained since she currently lives outside with her siblings, she is expected to learn quickly.

Inka is castrated, vaccinated, and microchipped.

Her adoption fee is £475, which includes a home check and full rescue backup provided by Ninas Haven, ensuring her new family receives comprehensive support.

name: Noel
description:
Noel is a 2-3 year old male Cross-Breed. He is a boy who was found near a cemetery in Vukovar in November.

No owner could be found. One of the team was asked if he could come to her to wait for his forever home.

Noel is a healthy, happy pup. Noel loves to play and has all the playful personality traits of a labrador. When he runs, he doesn’t realise that his bum is faster than his head!

Noel is all legs like a giraffe!! He is good with other dogs and can live with children but they must be over 8 years old as he could knock into them.

Noel is vaccinated, neutered, and microchipped.

We are a small UK charity that rescues abandoned and sometimes mistreated cats and dogs from Croatia.

We bring them back to health and try to rehome them. Unless otherwise stated all dogs are in Croatia ready to travel.

name: Stella
description:
Meet Stella – a gentle soul looking for her safe haven.

Stella is an eleven month old female Pocket Pointer Cross, weighing just seven kilograms.

When she first arrived, Stella was a very timid little girl – but with time, patience, and kindness she has begun to show just how much love she has to give.

She adores squeaky toys, tasty treats, and playing with other dogs. Stella is happiest in the company of her canine pals and would love to share her new home with a friendly doggy companion.

Mealtimes are a joy – she’s wonderfully polite, eats from her own bowl, and is very food-motivated, which makes training in safe and familiar spaces much easier.

Stella is still a shy soul who can be wary of strangers, sudden noises, and especially men’s voices, but once she feels safe she blossoms into a playful and affectionate companion. She is good with children once trust has been built, and would thrive in a calm, understanding family.

The outside world feels big and overwhelming for Stella right now. Walks, car journeys, and busy places are stressful for her, so she will need a patient adopter to help her progress gently at her own pace.

A secure garden or safe field where she can enjoy off-lead play until she’s ready for more would be ideal.

Because she bonds so deeply, Stella may struggle with being left alone, so she needs someone with plenty of time, patience, and love to devote to her.

Stella’s dream home would be with a kind female adopter (with or without children), ideally with another friendly dog to guide her. Any men in her life will need to give her space, patience, and the time she needs to feel relaxed in their company.

If you can offer Stella the safety, love, and gentle guidance she needs, she will reward you with a lifetime of loyalty and joy.

Please tell us a bit about yourself when you get in touch:

name: Reg
description:
Reg is a 1-2 year old male Cross-Breed. “I’m gorgeous don’t you think? I was found in a shed with my mummy and siblings. I have now come on leaps and bounds.

I’m a lovely boy who is full of beans and can’t wait for you to teach me how to play. I am people and dog friendly.

I haven’t been cat tested yet but this can be done. I have a place on the happy bus and will be in Derbyshire very soon.

I’d love to have a family of my own who I can make lots of fun memories with and snuggle up to. Is that you?

I am neutered, fully vaccinated, health checked and have full RBU. Adoption is subject to a home check.” – Quote

name: Skipper
description:
Skipper is a 2 year old Croatian Shepherd cross with a remarkable and resilient story.

Originally discovered in a ditch in Croatia at just 6 weeks old, he faced the challenge of adapting to life with only three legs, believed to be a condition from birth, along with a broken pelvis.

Despite these early hardships, Skipper has blossomed into a gorgeous, happy, and loving boy.

This resilient canine companion is currently seeking a new home due to compatibility issues with other dogs in his current household. His ideal home would be one with an experienced owner, preferably as the only dog.

Skipper, though he may bounce a bit due to his three legs, is a loyal and affectionate companion. He walks well on a lead, has good recall, and enjoys the outdoors. However, he may get sick in the car, though he has medication to address this.

Skipper’s loving nature is apparent in his eagerness to please his owners. He appreciates cuddles, adores going on walks, and has a keen interest in treats, making him amenable to training.

It’s essential to note that Skipper is protective of his humans and prefers not to share them with other resident dogs. He’s sensitive about his remaining back leg, and caution is advised when handling it. Maintaining a healthy weight is crucial for Skipper’s well-being.

Microchipped, rabies vaccinated, infectious diseases two times vaccinated, and castrated, Skipper is ready to find his forever home. While he may not be the best fit for a household with other dogs, he might coexist with a dog-savvy cat.

It’s recommended that any potential adopter has experience with dogs and can provide a secure environment for Skipper.

If you’re looking to give Skipper a loving home, situated in Milton Keynes, UK, and can offer him the undivided attention he craves, please consider adopting this resilient and charming canine companion.

A £395 adoption fee applies, and a home check is required, with Ninas Haven providing full rescue back up.

URGENT FOSTER REQUIRED ASAPIF NOT WILL HAVE TO GO TO KENNELS

Please share or get in touch if you can help.

name: Alexander
description:
Alexander is a medium-sized 4-year-old mixed breed dog with a lot of energy. He loves engaging in playful activities, particularly displaying a keen enthusiasm for football, and would greatly appreciate a companion who shares his passion for the sport.

This vibrant canine has undergone vaccinations, neutering, and comprehensive health checks, ensuring his well-being and making him a robust and resilient companion.

Friendly towards most dogs, Alexander showcases a sociable nature that can contribute to a harmonious canine environment. Despite his amiable disposition, he would thrive best as the sole dog in a household, and he is not particularly fond of sharing his living space with cats.

Alexander’s exuberant personality and zest for life make him an ideal match for an individual or family looking to add an active and spirited canine member to their home.

With a clean bill of health, vaccinations up-to-date, and the assurance of being neutered, he is ready to be bound into a new home and capture the hearts of those who appreciate his vivacious spirit.

The prospective adopter will find in Alexander a loyal companion, ready to embark on various adventures and share moments of joy in the journey of life.

name: Simba
description:
Simba is in need of a forever home. He is a 4 year old male JagdTerrier Cross. He is currently in foster and has been there for 6 months now where his foster has been carefully working with him and assessing him and his needs.

We now feel that we have enough information to find the home that he needs as we do not want to have to keep moving him around.

Unfortunately, his needs mean that he cannot stay with his foster, even though they care for him very much, the mutual agreement is that Simba has specific needs and is not able to continue living in a busy, built up area.

This boy has been through a lot. We are seeking a quiet, more rural home where he will feel safe, learn to let his guard down and have a bit more freedom to explore, sniff, and release some of his prey drive energy.

His foster believes if the opportunity arose, he would make a good working dog where his breeds strengths could be used. He needs an experienced owner who either knows his breed well, or has experience dealing with a reactive/prey driven dog.

This is a big ask, but we believe there is someone out there for this beautiful boy. We will be thoroughly vetting all applicants, so please only serious, experienced applications.

If anyone knows someone/a page that specialises in german hunting terriers/terriers, please let us know.

A note from Simba’s foster on his personality and behaviour:

“Having had very little exposure to normal life before coming to the UK, since being in foster Simba has learnt how to relax and is less bothered about daily household and living environment noises, but he has a tendency to have reactive behaviours when out and about and managing this can be challenging and is a work in progress.

Simba is very sensitive to sound and sight and has a very high prey drive. Outside the house, he is on high alert to anything that moves, which includes all vehicles, people, children, cyclists, cats, and joggers, so he needs very careful management and handling. He gets anxious in narrow or enclosed spaces and can get overwhelmed very quickly and needs to be given lots of space, or shielded when walking past reactivity triggers to avoid him lunging out, and he is conscious and anxious of things approaching from behind or suddenly appearing.

He has learnt some recall but can only be let off lead in certain circumstances when there are not too many distractions and unfamiliar people such as joggers, cyclists, children, etc. He can be very unsure of people he has not been introduced to, but is fine with those he has met regularly since being in foster, particularly those who have dogs, and those he has been carefully introduced to, but it has taken time for him build trust.

He can occasionally be a little reactive to some dogs he meets when he is on a short lead and so it is best to not let him approach new unfamiliar people and dogs unless carefully managed, and kept brief. Simba is always keen to see what’s going on on the other side of things both in and out of the house, and so he would need a VERY secure garden at home.

He finds busy built up places with people and cars challenging and needs careful management in those situations as they are triggers for reactivity, so I think a quiet rural setting would mean life is less challenging for him. Underneath his anxiety, Simba appears to be a submissive sensitive boy with a cheeky side to him.

Since being in foster, Simba has not been tested with children but has shown reactivity towards them when seeing them out and about, I’m not sure if he finds them exciting or threatening, but I don’t feel I would trust him with children. Simba has been trained to accept a muzzle, although he doesn’t like it.

Simba has a very, very strong hunting instinct, and is constantly looking and listening for prey to hunt or flush out, he would therefore need someone who is familiar with hunting dog instinct and experienced in managing reactive behaviour, and who is able to provide him with the mental and physical stimulation that his breed needs for his all round wellbeing.

Simba will want to chase cats, I believe there is a level of anxiety and fear that comes with seeing a cat. Simba developed extreme anxiety with moving objects when travelling in the car, and so he now travels well in a covered crate in the car. Simba cannot live with cats as his prey drive is too high.

Simba may do well with another calm dog in the household for company and playmate, preferably a female, but I think he has benefited from one-one attention and training while in foster. Simba will need a transition period from foster to a forever home in order to build trust and familiarity with new surroundings.”

Simba is microchipped, rabies vaccinated, infectious diseases two times vaccinated, bordatella vaccine will be recieved before transport, castrated, Mediterranean diseases tested-negative.

Adoption fee and home check applies, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

name: Benji
description:
BENJI is a 4 year old male podenco, currently at our holding kennels in Cordoba, Southern Spain.

We rescued Benji from a very busy municipal pound in central Spain. He had been collected by the authorities from a breeding hunter with his two equally terrified siblings, and was having a terrible time, sitting and shaking at the back of the pen, only daring to venture out if food was thrown.

He is much more confident since arriving at the shelter but it’s still difficult for him to trust – he still finds it difficult if somebody makes a quick movement or if he hears a loud noise, which is completely understandable given his background.

An escape artist, he jumps and scales very well so his adopter will need to be experienced with this type of dog and put into place proper security measures to keep him safe.

He loves other dogs and finds security in having them nearby so a home with a resident dog or dogs is essential for Benji. Ideally, a home in Spain is sought so that Benji doesn’t have to travel, but we will consider the UK if the right home is found.

Benji is a Podenco and was a working dog – please research the breed-specific needs of the Podenco before applying.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Benji is neutered. Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck, adoption checks and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Frederick
description:
Frederick is a 1 year old male drahthaar cross, currently at our holding kennels in Cordoba, Southern Spain.

Admitted as a 6-month old puppy after having been abandoned at a municipal pound, Frederick was understandably scared of everything around him.

He was very nervous and didn’t understand how to walk on a lead or socialise with humans and other dogs.

After some months in our care, and with lots of new friends to give him confidence, he has really come out of his shell and has turned into the sweetest, most affectionate dog.

He can still be a bit nervous of people when he first meets them, so a low-activity home without children (over 8 for adoption only please) would be better for him.

He really wants to be friends with the humans he meets, but he waits until he is sure that they are not going to harm him before he makes a commitment – he will back off until he is sure so his adopter must be patient and understand his need to be introduced to new people and situations in his own time.

Frederick is still a puppy and loves to run and play but he is not destructive and will relax if nothing is going on, and considering his age, he is very well behaved.

He shares a kennel with his best friend, older Breton Aroa, who he adores – it would be amazing if they could be adopted together but he can also be adopted alone, as long as there is a welcoming calm resident dog in the family, who will help him with his confidence.

Frederick is a Drahthaar X and may have been a working dog – please research the breed-specific needs of the Drahthaar before applying.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis. All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised.

Frederick is neutered. Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck, adoption checks and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Indiana Jones
description:
Indiana Jones is a 1-2 year old male Cross-Breed, currently at our holding kennels in Southern Spain. He was thrown over the fence at the municipal pound one night and left to his fate.

Unsurprisingly, when admitted into our care, he was very nervous, and he is still a bit wary of people that he doesn’t know. However, the moment he realises that you are not going to hurt him, he’ll jump up and shower you with kisses!

Indi is a medium active dog and loves to run but in moderation. He is also good with all the other dogs at the shelter and loves to play with them.

Indi would be better in a home with another resident dog as he gains confidence from having other dogs around. He will need a low-activity quiet home who can give him lots of time.

Indiana Jones is negative for all infectious diseases, including Brucella canis.

name: Felix
description:
Felix is an 11-month-old male Cross-Breed. He was rescued from a council pound after his seven days were up and no one came to claim him.

It is believed he was deliberately abandoned by his previous owner, as he wasn’t microchipped and no one came forward. Thankfully, he was taken into a safe kennel foster space, sparing him from a tragic fate.

Felix has clearly had some training in the past, as he knows basic commands like sit, lie down, and ‘finish’—a position where he sits by your left side.

He is intelligent and eager to learn, offering great eye contact and responding well to positive reinforcement, especially treats. He is also fully house-trained and loves affection and fuss.

Felix is playful and active, enjoying games of fetch and running around the garden. He gives off a high-pitched bark when playing and a deeper bark when alerting to something unusual. He’s curious and nosey, often standing on his back legs to get a better look at what’s going on around him.

He walks best using a headcollar harness and a dual-control lead, as he can be strong on the lead but is improving with training. Felix could potentially live with a calm, well-mannered female dog, but he may react if approached aggressively by other dogs.

Due to the lack of background information and his size and energy levels, Felix would be best suited to an adult-only home or one with children aged 12 and over. He is not cat tested, so his compatibility with cats is unknown.

An experienced owner who has previously had large-breed dogs is recommended to help guide Felix into a balanced adult life.

name: Ziggy
description:
Ziggy is a 6year old male cross breed located in Spain.

Gentle boy Ziggy is a large Retriever-cross boy with a black, soft, lush coat. Poor boy has been in Foster since last April, as he was very poorly when he was rescued, but now is in very good health and has come a long way by benefitting being in foster care.

He has learnt how to respond very well to commands, and also he is ok with other dogs on his walks, and good on lead. Ziggy is house trained, and he travels well in the car, and can be left home for short periods without any issues.

He is a gentle plodder and very affectionate and well behaved. Unfortunately, his foster mum has had an accident and can no longer walk Ziggy, and we really don’t want him to have to return to the shelter.

So now, we urgently seek a quiet home with or without other friendly dogs and children over 10 years.

Ziggy has sponsorship which makes his adoption fee reduced

His Best Points:Affectionate, gentle, inquisitive and puppyish all in one.

Foster Report:Ziggy is a special fur baby (aren’t they all!). He has blossomed from being almost a walking skeleton and almost unable to see, to a lively, sweet, affectionate dog who wants to be friends with everybody, human and canine.

He has no issues walking past dogs on leads but does not really like loose dogs approaching.

He does not really notice cats unless they run. He is a big dog but still has puppy energy and needs a considerate owner who will continue to work with him to build him up, inside and out and assure him the world isn’t a scary place.

He has now learnt to walk to heel. He is learning commands such as sit and lay down with the aid of treats. Ziggy knows the “LEAVE” command. He has become used to travelling in the car, but needs reassurance when exiting in particular, as he can get disorientated.

It’s best Ziggy is fed alone as he can occasionally be protective over his food. Ziggy can be left alone for an hour or two with no evidence of separation anxiety. Ziggy has been aound young children was perfectly behaved even when they tried to ride him!! Well done Ziggy.

name: Rupert
description:
Rupert is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed who is a loving young boy and would love a home of his own. He is such a playful chap.

He is the last of his litter to find a home sadly.

Rupert has been cat tested which is great and he is fine with other dogs.

A suitable home would be one with no small children as he is not used to them but with a family, couple or individual who can give the attention he craves.

He is neutered, microchipped and has been fully vaccinated.

He has also had all the required blood tests to comply with DEFRA.

He would be transported to his new home via an accredited transport van.

Please consider him. He is so wanting a home of his own and an owner to play with!

name: Albi
description:
ALBI – A War Hero Who Found His Smile Again: A New Dog in a New Life. ALBI is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Adoption fee significantly reduced

Meet ALBI, a 9 -year-old small-sized corgi type. ALBI once walked the front lines of war, shoulder-to-shoulder with Ukrainian soldiers. But in the UK, we misunderstood him terribly.

We thought he needed peace and quiet. We placed him with elderly people, in silent homes with no other pets. But he was miserable. He was misunderstood, unhappy, and reactive—trying to tell us something we failed to hear.

Then something beautiful happened. When ALBI was just days away from being sent to kennels, a wonderful foster stepped in—and everything changed.

Now living in an active household with children and dogs, ALBI is a completely different dog. His foster says:

“He’s the most perfect dog I’ve ever met. Kind, loving, grateful. He adores being part of the action—bonfires, walks, games, relaxing by your side—he just wants to be included.”

“He loves kids—especially calm, dog-savvy ones—and he adores other dogs. Even shy or reactive dogs feel safe with him because he reads them so well and gives them space. He’s playful, gentle, and so grateful for every moment. Even visitors don’t upset him anymore—he’s just relaxed and joyful.”

ALBI has finally shown us who he really is. This is his fresh start. And now he needs the right home to match.

Rescue StoryALBI is a war survivor. He lived with soldiers in trenches under shelling—eating scraps, keeping watch, offering comfort. They described him as the “most loyal companion” they’d known. After the war, he was rescued and brought to the UK. But sadly, he ended up passed from one wrong home to another—quiet places that didn’t match his spirit.

In one of those homes in England, ALBI was terribly mistreated. He was misunderstood and punished—possibly even physically. His stress and anxiety spiralled, and shockingly, he was booked for euthanasia by someone who claimed “he doesn’t deserve to live around people.”

Thankfully, we found out in time and took him back. When he returned to his previous foster, she was heartbroken to see how much he’d changed—nervous, reactive, broken in spirit. But even after all of that, ALBI’s heart was still open.

But ALBI never gave up. And today, in a home full of life and love, is ALBI finally at peace.

Detailed InformationALBI is full of heart. He loves other dogs and needs to live with them—they help him feel joyful. He’s clever, wise, and respectful, especially around timid or fearful pups. He also absolutely adores children—but only gentle, calm ones who understand dogs.

He loves his walks, his garden time, and just being part of the family routine. His former reactivity? Gone. His fear of visitors? Gone. Even around men, he now behaves beautifully, simply because he’s happy and no longer stressed or bored.

ALBI sleeps soundly, enjoys soft beds, and lives for companionship. He’s not a loner—he wants to be where his people and his pack are. He doesn’t need a mansion, just a home full of love and movement, and people who will include him in their world.

Ideal HomeALBI is seeking an active, loving home with at least one other friendly dog (the more the merrier). A secure garden is a must. The older children who are kind and respectful will be welcomed by him with open paws.

He’d suit a home where someone is around most of the time—he loves his humans deeply. A calm but lively household where he can be included in walks, playtime, and snuggles is exactly what he’s been waiting for.

ALBI is a new dog in a new life. After everything he’s been through—from war trenches to emotional neglect—he’s finally happy. And we owe it to him to keep it that way.ALBI has come through war and heartbreak, and still, he chooses to love. He was let down—more than once—and yet here he is, smiling again. He just needs a family to keep that smile on his face.

If you’ve got a home with wagging tails, gentle hands, a few muddy walks and space on your sofa for a small, loyal war hero… ALBI is ready to give you his whole heart.

Health InformationALBI is in good health. Neutered. Fully vaccinated. Microchipped. Needs mild weight loss and joint supplements. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Stevie
description:
Stevie is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed. This young fellow was abandoned with others and has been taken into foster with an English lady in Romania.

He is living with other pups and a surrogate mum and dad dog, so he is getting lots of doggy socialising.

Stevie has never lived in a house, but most of our dogs adapt quite quickly.

It is very hot over there at the moment, so the dogs tend to stay in their shelters, but we managed to get a few photos of this good-looking chap.

He will be a medium-sized adult and would love a doggy friend to teach him the ropes.

He will be fully vaccinated, wormed, and given flea treatment before he travels.

All our dogs have pet passports which contain all of their medical interventions.

Hopefully, we will be able to neuter him before he travels. He will travel by van directly to see his new adopter in the UK.

name: Bowie
description:
Bowie is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is an affectionate big dog full of love and is craving human care.

This sweet boy has been waiting for a while to find his forever home. Bowie is neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, making him a well-prepared companion for a new family.

He weighs between 32 kg and 35 kg and stands about 52 cm tall, making him a large dog with a gentle personality.

Bowie currently resides in a run with another dog but could also thrive as an only dog in the right home.

His loving nature makes him well-suited to live with a couple, an individual, or potentially a family with older children. He seeks companionship and affection and would benefit from being in a home where he can receive the care and attention he craves.

Bowie has waited for a long time to find his special person, and he would love nothing more than to settle into a home where he can be loved for life.

The rescue offers lifetime support to ensure Bowie transitions smoothly into his new home. His calm, affectionate nature makes him a great fit for someone looking for a loyal and loving companion.

He is ready to bring joy to a family or individual who can provide the space, care, and affection he needs.

name: Millie
description:
Millie is a beautiful temperament, always happy, loving cross-breed girl of around 2 years old.

She is super friendly with everyone – kids, dogs, cats. Great on the lead. Housetrained. Based in Peterborough, available for foster-to-adopt. Reduced adoption fees

Unfortunately, a few days ago, Millie had to go to boarding kennels as all our current fosters are fully booked. While this is likely one of the best kennels you can find, staffed by true dog lovers with great facilities, an on-site behaviorist, and a focus on rehabilitation, it’s still not the same as a home.

They offer wonderful care, take the dogs on walks, and play with them, but it can’t replace the love and comfort of a real family. We’re praying that this sweet girl finds her forever home soon.

Before this Millie was at foster in UK and this is what they say:

“Millie is a very sweet, attractive and affectionate young dog. She likes people and to be with people and is normally docile and friendly. She likes to be stroked and groomed and to have her belly rubbed.

She likes exploring but doesn’t try and escape from the garden or run off when out for a walk. She likes to play with toys, especially in the evening out in the garden. She will readily sit on command and shake a paw!

She is very good off the lead, walking along paths, in fields and in the woods etc in the countryside, and she will regularly look back and check that you are there and come back when called.

She is very friendly with people she meets and will regularly sniff them (to check they are human) as you walk along, though she is slightly nervous of other larger dogs until she gets to know them. She will happily chase and play with other dogs she feels comfortable with. If they are too much she will do a little growl and they will usually back off.

However, we have come across a few behavioural issues. The main issue appears ‘resource guarding’ and the things she guards have increased and changed whilst she has been with us. This can be unpredictable and takes us by surprise at times. For instance we might be happily working in the same room as Millie who’s in her bed, coming and going and talking to her.

Suddenly she will change and growl, snarl if we re-enter the room. She also will suddenly and unpredictably snarl in other places where she’s lying down. Another example is that we are both hesitant of trying to move her off the sofa.

The only safe way is to call her from another room, sometimes with a treat to lure her. This may be because for some reason Millie has not really settled with us after nearly four weeks and still feels insecure.

I think Millie will need to be with family who are experienced with dogs, who can interpret her body language and behaviour, and be able train with her to reduce and prevent her very marked resource guarding (rescue will be happy to provide useful and working materials to treat it). I think this shouldn’t be a family with young children but teenagers and older children should be okay if they are aware of what not to do.”

MILLIE is active but not hyper, always happy, not pushy. Very loving and loves cuddles and fuss. Loves people company and being nearby.

MILLIE is very smart, loves learning new things. But the most she likes is walks being active and having attention from people.MILLIE is good in the car and loves it.

MILLIE has no known health issues. Spayed, vaccinated, microchipped. Brucella C. tested.

name: Aran
description:
Aran is an 18-month-old male Cross-Breed.

He has spent his entire life in a foster shelter, patiently awaiting his forever home. As one of several siblings in need of adoption, Aran has developed a friendly and sociable nature, making him a wonderful companion.

He is cat-tested and has demonstrated a good ability to coexist with feline friends, which is a positive trait for potential adopters with cats.

Additionally, Aran is accustomed to living with other dogs, showing that he can thrive in a multi-dog household.

Expected to be a small-sized adult dog, he would be well-suited to various living environments, including smaller homes or apartments.

Aran is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and has undergone all the necessary tests for travel, ensuring that he is well-prepared for his new home.

His affectionate disposition and readiness for adoption make him an excellent choice for anyone looking to add a loving and well-adjusted dog to their family.

name: Pearl
description:
Pearl is an 18-month-old female Cross-Breed who was originally found in a forest with her siblings and brought into foster care. She was only 5 months old when she first entered rescue, and since then, she has spent the majority of her young life in foster care.

Despite her early start in rescue, Pearl is a friendly and sociable young dog who is now eagerly searching for her forever home.

Pearl is expected to grow into a medium-sized adult dog. She has already been fully vaccinated, microchipped, and has had all the necessary blood tests required to come to the UK. This means that she is in good health and ready to move to her new home once the right family is found.

Being a young dog, Pearl is very adaptable and social, and she enjoys being around people. She thrives on human interaction and would make an affectionate companion.

As Pearl has spent most of her life in care, she is used to the attention and care provided by foster families, which will make her transition into a permanent home easier.

In addition to her physical health, Pearl comes with full RBU (Return to Base) support. This means that her new family will have ongoing assistance throughout her life to ensure that any questions or concerns are addressed.

This safety net is a great reassurance for potential adopters, knowing that they will not be alone in the process of welcoming Pearl into their lives.

Pearl is ready to find a home where she can continue to grow and thrive. Her sociable nature and friendly disposition make her an ideal companion for those seeking a loving and active dog.

Whether as part of a family or as an individual pet, Pearl is sure to bring joy and affection into her new home.

name: Iris
description:
Iris is a 2-3 year old female Lurcher. She is great with people. Iris will need a pet and child-free home.

We are looking for either a foster or a forever home. She’s a fun-loving dog. Who just wants to be loved? If you think you can offer her lots of love and a sofa to sleep on.

name: Freya
description:
Freya, a 5 year old female Labrador Cross, has been patiently waiting in the foster shelter for quite a while after being rescued from a kill shelter in Romania.

We can’t understand why someone hasn’t fallen for her before.

Freya loves attention from her humans and lives with other dogs.

She has been neutered and fully vaccinated as well as microchipped.

She would be delivered directly to her new adopter once admin checks have been carried out.

Please consider this lovely girl for a place on the Happy Bus to a new life here in the UK.

name: Holly
description:
Holly, 1 year old female Cross-Breed, and her two sisters were found dumped by waste bins in an alley in Romania at six weeks old.

They have been in a foster shelter since then, and their English foster mum has brought them on well.

They are in a pen with some other pups and a surrogate mum and dad dog, which teaches them doggy manners!

Holly is neutered and fully vaccinated. She is also microchipped.

She would be delivered directly to her new owners once admin checks have been done.

It would be wonderful if she could have a doggy friend to live with, but this is not essential.

Two of her kennel mates have already travelled to their new homes in the UK, and it would be lovely if Holly could too.

Full rescue backup is given on all of our dogs.

name: Pennie
description:
Pennie is an 13 months old, female, cross-breed pup who, along with her siblings, faced abandonment in woodland in Romania at a very young age.

Fortunately, they found refuge in a foster shelter where they have been nurtured ever since.

This sweet and slightly shy pup exhibits a calm demeanor, making her an ideal companion for those with experience in dog ownership.

As a good-sized medium dog, Pennie will undergo neutering before embarking on her journey to a new home in the UK.

Her health is meticulously documented in her pet passport, with full vaccination and microchipping completed.

Comprehensive blood tests have been conducted to ensure a smooth integration into her new life.

Pennie, being fully cat-tested with a video available for potential adopters, proves her compatibility with feline friends.

Ideally suited for a family with older children due to her size, Pennie would thrive in an environment where her adopters possess previous dog ownership experience.

To facilitate a seamless transition, we offer full rescue backup and a commitment to ongoing support, ensuring the continued well-being of our canine charges.

Pennie eagerly awaits a loving home, ready to bring joy and companionship to a family in the UK.

name: Bailey
description:
He is a super boy and a lovely goofball. Bailey is neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped, making him ready for his forever home.

Standing at approximately 60cm tall and weighing around 40 kg, he is a friendly and sizeable companion.

Despite his large stature, Bailey’s gentle nature makes him an ideal addition to any loving household.

He is eager to find a home where he can share his affection and playful energy.

Bailey’s charming personality makes him a delightful companion for anyone seeking a loyal canine friend.

name: Ava
description:
Ava is a 6-year-old female Cross-Breed who is very friendly and playful.

She has been neutered, microchipped, and vaccinated, making her fully prepared for her new home.

Ava weighs approximately 28 kg and stands around 48 cm tall.

This sweet girl is eager to find a home where she can be loved and cared for.

Ava’s playful nature and friendly disposition make her a delightful companion.

She would thrive in a home where she can receive plenty of attention and affection.

name: Murphy
description:
Meet MURPHY, a gentle, loving, and resilient small boy around 4.5 years old, who resembles a charming mix of Corgi and Chihuahua. He is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven.

Available for a foster-to-adopt. Already in UK: Clapham (London), SW11. Adoption fee reduced.

He lost one eye in a horrific incident in Ukraine, but his spirit remains unbroken. He’s now in the UK and looking for a forever home where he can be cherished. Sadly, the family who took him in feels they are not the right match for him and are unable to meet his needs.

They have provided a thorough evaluation of MURPHY, which you can read below.

Rescue Story:MURPHY’s story is one of love, resilience, and heartbreak. He was abandoned in a communal garden in Ukraine, where he was embraced by the local residents. They cared for him, and he became part of their extended family, playing with children and happily resting in his little kennel.

Tragically, some cruel teenagers thought it would be amusing to chase MURPHY and throw a petard into his kennel. After the explosion, MURPHY was left severely injured, his face burned and bleeding, and his eye tragically lost. However, despite this horror, MURPHY’s spirit remained unbroken.

He was rushed to a clinic, treated, and later brought into a rescue. Through it all, MURPHY continued to trust humans, showing the true resilience of a dog’s heart.

A Word from His Current Family:“ He is a lovely little dog, with a strong and great spirit. Murphy is a rescue from Ukraine who came to us in June 2024. He only has one eye due to an incident where he was attacked by some teenagers who threw a firework / explosive into his little den.

Since then he was taken into care and fostered for.

A highly independent little soul, he loves his alone time and is never anxious in these periods. He loves his sleep and will find sun spots and cozy little nooks to snuggle up in.

Positives? Good to be left alone for short periods, very calm and sleeps a lot? Doesn’t destroy things in house? Independent? Enjoys good play time and belly rubs when he rolls over? Not a fussy eater? Will sit for snacks and treats? Handsome? Very low maintenance, will shed a couple times a year.? Travels well, loves car and train journeys

Needs? Child free house? A quieter house, less footfall to not disturb him? Only dog in house

Things to know? Give him space and wait for him to come to you. He will and he loves chin and ear scratches? Resource guard, work on splitting his meals up and make him back away from food bowl before topping up. He has improved.? Don’t pick him up? Leave alone when in his bed (trained safe space)? Keep on lead when on walks? Takes pain relief pills for previous accident.– has snapped on occasion, when was misunderstood, but not regularly and not his fault. Needs patience and understanding for all he’s been through

Due to his injuries and impaired vision he can be easily startled if approached from his right.

Requiring a very calm and peaceful life. Super low maintenance and highly independent, he is equally happy when alone or in company of owners. Give him space and wait for him to come to you, he loves chin and ear scratches. He’s a great little dog to have around and keep you company.

He will nuzzle up to you for some love and scratches and then spend the rest of night tucked up in his bed. He has adapted well to his new life in the UK and is very healthy.

Fully vaccinated and blood tests all came back healthy. He doesn’t require long walks and can be tired out after half hour to an hour”

MURPHY is fully healthy (but missing one eye), neutered. All core vaccines are complete, microchipped, and C.Brucella tested (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

name: Poppy
description:
Poppy is a 7-year-old female Cross-Breed. She was abandoned in the woods of Romania alongside another mother and eleven puppies.

Sadly, only six of the puppies survived and have since been adopted, but Poppy has remained in the shelter for two and a half years, patiently waiting for her forever home.

She is a shy but loving girl whose entire demeanour brightens when she receives human attention.

With gentle care, she blossoms into an affectionate and grateful companion. She gets along well with other dogs and cats, making her a great addition to a multi-pet household.

Poppy walks well on the lead, though she will need time to adjust and may benefit from some further training. At around 35 kg and 50 cm tall, she is a medium-sized dog with a gentle presence.

She has been spayed and is fully vaccinated, ensuring she is ready for a fresh start in a loving home.

After waiting so long, Poppy deserves a family that will cherish her. She is looking for a patient and understanding owner who will help her settle into home life.

Could you be the one to offer her the home of her dreams? Full rescue backup (RBU) is provided.

name: Minnie
description:
Minnie is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed puppy, playful and trusting, yet sadly overlooked. She is small-medium in size, weighing 16 kg and standing at 50-51 cm, perfect for a knee-height companion.

MINNIE was originally found near the road, her mum was hit by the car and didn’t survive. She was a tiny puppy and had no chance to survive if volunteers in Belarus would not rescue her.

She went to a Foster family together with her brother Alex. Alex was happily Adopted in UK. Minnie arrived in UK in June , and still dreams about her forever home.

MINNIE is at Foster now, with other dogs and older kids. And this is what they say:

” What a joy it’s been to train such a smart and eager pup like Minnie! In just 3 weeks at our foster home, she’s made remarkable improvement in impulse control, obedience, and even tried her paw at agility exercises with so much excitement. Can you believe how far she’s come in such a short time?Previously, we mentioned some of her challenges, but let’s see how she’s improved:

“Can be unsure around pushchairs.” Not anymore! Minnie is now completely calm around pushchairs, whether they’re coming toward her, walking beside her, or passing by. She’s unbothered and confident.

“May bark or chew on your shoes sometimes.” While Minnie still loves to carry shoes around the house, we’re working on giving her a more appropriate comfort object. It seems to be a part of her young age, but she’s already shifting her focus to healthier chew options like bones, Kongs, or long-lasting treats like dried ears and tails.

Minnie’s even turned it into a game—she loves tossing treats in the air and chasing them around the house. And the best part? No more barking at home! When she first arrived, she was quite demanding, but now she patiently waits for her meals, even with our two other dogs around.

She’s grown more confident and no longer feels the need to follow us like a shadow. While we haven’t left her alone at home yet, she’s happy to stay in a room by herself as long as the door is open.

“Reactive on walks.” Minnie can be reactive if we’re not fully focused on her, but we lovingly call her our “mindfulness trainer” for this reason. When we stay engaged—by changing pace, asking her to come, throwing treats for her to find—she’s fantastic.

No distractions from birds, squirrels, or even people. It’s only when we get distracted ourselves that some of her reactivity returns, so with the right attention, Minnie is a joy to walk!

“Sometimes unsure around kids or female dogs.” Minnie is improving here, too. She’s now playful with most dogs, regardless of their size or gender.

When it comes to children, she can still be a bit reactive, especially when they approach her too quickly, but with patience and positive reinforcement, she’s getting better.

MINNIE is adorable pup, too young to be perfect in everything. She is can be nervous and shy at start but she is very friendly and playful. She is very loving, very curious and smart.

MINNIE can be unsure of young kids,  but she loves older kids 13+. She will perfectly suit home with the other friendly and confident  large or medium male dog as really enjoy canine company

MINNIE has no known health issues; not spayed (arrived 5 months ago at early age, rescue will contribute to costs). Full vaccination pack, provided worms treatment, microchipped. Brucella C. tested.

name: Cerys
description:
Cerys is a 5-month-old female cross breed dog who was discovered alongside two other female pups abandoned on the roadside in Romania.

Currently, she is under the care of an English lady living in Romania. She is described as a smallish mixed breed dog and has been socialized with larger resident dogs, exhibiting good compatibility with them.

Cerys has completed her vaccination regimen and has been microchipped, in addition to undergoing all the necessary blood tests to meet DEFRA regulations for dogs originating from other countries.

It’s anticipated that she will grow into a small to medium-sized adult dog, weighing approximately 15 kg to 18 kg.

Cerys is adaptable to various living situations, suitable for a family, a couple, or an individual, and she has a laid-back demeanor for her age.

While she would appreciate having a canine companion, it’s not an essential requirement for her. Although she hasn’t been tested with cats yet, there’s a possibility of conducting such a test before her relocation.

Full rescue support is provided for all dogs, including Cerys, when necessary.

She eagerly awaits the opportunity for a fresh start in the UK and would thrive in a loving home environment. Her sisters Inca and Holly are also seeking new homes.

name: Angel
description:
Angel is a 3-year-old female Cross-Breed. She exudes a charming and friendly demeanour, often engaging in playful antics that highlight her affectionate nature.

Her gentle personality and warmth make her a lovely companion, whether during playtime or quiet moments at home.

Angel’s playful side is balanced by her calm and loving temperament, making her well-suited for a variety of households.

Having been neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, Angel is in excellent health and ready for her forever home.

Her responsible care has ensured that she’s in great condition, both physically and emotionally. Weighing 26 kg and standing at around 50 cm tall, she is a moderately sized dog, reflecting her mixed-breed heritage.

Her size makes her adaptable to different living environments, whether in a larger house or a cosy home.

Angel’s endearing personality extends to her social interactions with other dogs.

She gets along well with them, showing her ability to fit in with a multi-dog household. Her friendly and approachable nature is sure to make her a delightful addition to any family.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a 9 to 10 year old male Cross-Breed, looking for his retirement home!

He is a small Cross-Breed dog and a handsome chap.

He is waiting in foster in Kings Lynn, Norfolk and on reservation, he would be brought over directly to his new owner’s home.

Sam is a little shy at first and is a bit wary of men, but with time and love, he would be fine.

He would suit a couple or individual, possibly retired.

He deserves to spend the rest of his life in his forever home with lots of love.

We are told that he is about 9 or 10, but he looks younger.

Please consider this gorgeous boy. We provide lifetime RBU.

name: Meg
description:
She is one of two siblings who are currently awaiting their forever homes.

Despite her age, Meg is still a young and vibrant dog who has been waiting for a year without any interest from potential adopters.

Meg is known for her friendly and approachable nature.

She has been neutered, ensuring she won’t contribute to overpopulation. Meg is microchipped, which helps in identifying her should she ever get lost.

She is fully vaccinated, providing her with protection against common canine diseases.

Additionally, she has been tested for Brucellosis and other relevant conditions, ensuring her health status is well-documented.

Although Meg has not yet found her forever home, she remains hopeful and ready to bring joy and companionship to a new family.

If you are looking for a loving and well-cared-for dog, Meg might be the perfect addition to your home.

name: Lucky
description:
Lucky is an 18-month-old female Cross-Breed.

Lucky is a medium-sized, friendly dog who has spent most of her life in a foster shelter in Romania.

She stands about 49 cm tall and is known for her sociable nature.

Lucky is comfortable around other dogs, as she currently shares a kennel with them and could potentially live with another dog in her new home.

She is neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and has her own pet passport.

Lucky will be delivered directly to her new adopter after completing the necessary admin checks.

We offer lifetime rescue back-up for all our dogs, ensuring ongoing support for both the dog and their new family.

name: Jerry
description:
Jerry is a 3.5 year old male large terrier cross, currently in kennels in Humberside.

Jerry is a sensitive and complex soul with a big heart, seeking an experienced owner who can provide the structure and love he deserves.

Sadly, Jerry’s life has not been smooth since arriving in the UK, spending much of his time in kennels.

He loves calm people and enjoys walking, playing, and exploring, though he gets stressed in new situations.

Jerry thrives in a rural environment and is clean in his kennel.

This loyal boy needs a semi-rural or countryside home without children or small animals.

He is unsure of cyclists but loves his food and would benefit from ongoing training and support to help him feel safe and loved.

name: Heidi
description:
Heidi is a 5-year-old female Schipperke Cross. She is a small-sized dog who can be a little worried at first, but once she trusts someone, she becomes incredibly affectionate.

She loves to greet her favourite person with excitement, cuddling into them and rolling over for tummy rubs.

In the home, Heidi is clean and non-destructive. She is comfortable being left alone for a few hours and enjoys her walks and little adventures. She will be a devoted and loyal companion to the right person.

Heidi can be anxious at times and requires an experienced owner who understands her needs. She is protective of her person and may guard them from others, so she will need a one-person household.

A quiet, adult-only home with minimal visitors would be the best environment for her.

While Heidi mixes well with other dogs, she prefers to have her own space and should be the only dog in the home. She cannot live with cats.

name: Toby
description:
Toby is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed who is an extremely friendly and gentle boy.

This gorgeous dog weighs around 40 kg and stands approximately 65 cm tall.

Toby has a loving nature and adores people, making him a wonderful companion.

He is neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped, and also comes with a lifetime RBU (Return to Base) offer, ensuring support throughout his life.

Toby is ready to find a loving home where he can continue to share his affectionate personality and enjoy a fulfilling life.

name: Delia
description:
Delia is a 2-year-old female Spanish Mastin Cross, with clear sighthound traits in her appearance and behaviour. She is looking for a forever home where she can continue to build her confidence and trust.

When she was first rescued, Delia was extremely shy and fearful, struggling to adjust to her new surroundings. However, thanks to the patience and care of her foster home, she has made remarkable progress.

Now, Delia is much more relaxed and even seeks out affection from those she trusts. She enjoys cuddles and is beginning to show her loving and gentle personality. When out on walks, she is happy to meet new people and other dogs, showing how far she has come in her journey. Her ability to adapt and grow is truly heartwarming.

She gets along very well with other dogs and would benefit from having a calm and confident canine companion in her new home. A steady presence would help her continue to blossom and discover the world at her own pace. Delia is also great with cats, making her a versatile addition to a multi-pet household.

As a sensitive and affectionate soul, Delia deserves a family that will provide her with love, patience, and security. She is currently in Spain but is ready to travel to the UK for adoption. With the right home, she will thrive and form a deep bond with her new family.

If you are interested in giving Delia the loving home she deserves, please reach out to learn more about her and see additional videos.

name: Denzel
description:
Denzel is fostered in Mattishall Norfolk.

Denzel is a small to medium-sized crossbreed, around 2 to 3 years old, with the cutest little legs and a long body that suggests there might be a bit of Corgi and Spaniel somewhere in his family tree.

Whatever his mix, one thing is certain, he’s absolutely adorable.

Denzel’s story didn’t begin with the love and security every dog deserves. He was rescued from a pack of dogs surviving on the streets of Romania, in an area where cruelty towards dogs was sadly commonplace.

Many of the dogs rescued alongside him had suffered horrific injuries, including broken limbs. Miraculously, Denzel escaped without any major physical injuries, but the emotional scars of his past are harder to see.

Because of this, Denzel is understandably cautious around new people. He isn’t the sort of dog who will throw himself into the arms of strangers, and that’s okay.

He simply needs someone willing to let him go at his own pace. The beautiful thing about Denzel is that once you’ve earned his trust, his cheeky, affectionate personality begins to shine through.

He’s sweet, quietly funny, and has so much love tucked away, just waiting for the right person to discover it.

Denzel is currently living happily in a multi-dog foster home and absolutely thrives with canine company. Watching him with the other dogs is lovely!

He’s relaxed, confident, and enjoys playing when he thinks the humans aren’t looking! Because of how much he relies on other dogs for reassurance, he will need at least one friendly, confident resident dog in his forever home.

Cats, however… let’s just say the relationship between Denzel and the Safe Rescue cat is less of a friendship and more of a mutual agreement to disagree! For that reason, he is looking for a cat-free home.
