Denzel could happily live with sensible, respectful children aged 12 years and over who understand that he will need time, patience and space to settle.

Denzel isn’t looking for perfection. He isn’t looking for someone who expects an instant best friend. He’s looking for someone who understands that love built on trust is worth waiting for.

If you’re the kind of person who celebrates the little victories… a first tail wag, a gentle nudge for affection, a dog choosing to lie beside you because he finally feels safe, then Denzel might just be the one you’ve been waiting for.

name: Boris
description:
Boris is a large sized crossbreed aged around 11 years old.Boris fostered Watton, Norfolk.

Boris is a large dog who is unaware that his size doesn’t equate to him being a lap dog, however hard he tries. He is a gentle giant who loves nothing more than nuzzling up to his foster family for cuddles and kisses.

He spends most of his time as if a shadow of his fosterers, wherever we go, he goes. Whatever you are doing in the house, Boris will be right there by your side.

He loves his walks and can be out for quite some time, he also likes going to an enclosed field for a runaround and his favourite activity, a roll in the grass. He walks wonderfully on the lead and plods along nicely.

He loves his humans and gets the zoomies daily when his fosterers get home from work, as well as an incredibly waggy tail.

Apart from his spurts of energy, Boris is a very chilled out dude who likes the simple things of walks, food, fuss, and sleep.

Boris currently lives in a home with other dogs but would be quite happy to be the only dog in the house, where attention to him can be undivided. He cannot live with cats. He needs an adult home.

name: Ree
description:
Ree is a medium sized crossbreed aged around fourteen months old. Ree fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Ree and her sister Rox were found in the middle of nowhere in Romania, near a road, obviously abandoned, without food, water, or shelter.

It was last summer, when temperatures were soaring outside. They were taken by the Animal Police and taken to Roxana’s shelter.

Ree is a loving and loyal girl with a cheeky personality. She is initially shy of new people and new situations but is growing in confidence in her foster home.

She is wary of traffic and will need a rural home or quietish area where she can have time to grow in confidence out and about.

She mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home. She will need a cat free home and can live with children aged eight plus.

name: Bruna
description:
Bruna is a female, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old. Bruna fostered Hempnall Norfolk

Bruna and her mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Bruna is initially a little timid but is learning the ways of her new world in her UK foster home. She would benefit from the company of another dog in her foster home but could also be the only pet.

She would be ok to live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a medium sized crossbreed. Her passport says she is aged around four years old but we think she could be around six or seven. Lola fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Lola and her four pups were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Lola is a calm, sweet and friendly girl who enjoys the company of people. Unusually she seems particularly drawn to men but she is happy to get attention from everyone.

She walks nicely on a lead and enjoys her walks. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

Lola could live with another calm dog if it wasn’t too in her personal space but would probably prefer to be the only dog in the home. She’s not great with cats.

name: Boba
description:
Boba is a small crossbreed male aged around ten months old. Boba fostered Dereham Norfolk.

Boba was rescued from a landfill site in Romania along with his brother. He is now in a UK foster home and waiting for the offer of a forever home.

Boba is a sweet and friendly little chap who loves humans and other dogs alike. He enjoys his walks and loves playing with his toys. He is a cuddly and affectionate little chap.

Boba could live with or without other dogs in his forever home and will need all of the usual training input that an adolescent dog requires.

He isn’t cat tested. But can live with respectful children 5plus

name: Juny
description:
Juny is a female, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old.Juny fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Juny and her mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Juny is the most confident of the siblings and the quickest to learn the ways of her new world in her UK foster home. She would benefit from the company of another dog in her foster home but could also be the only pet.

She would be ok to live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Zora
description:
Zora is a female, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old. Zora fostered Norwich Norfolk

Zora and her mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Zora is initially a little timid but is learning the ways of her new world in her UK foster home. She would benefit from the company of another dog in her foster home but could also be the only pet.

She would be ok to live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Daniel
description:
Daniel is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around three years old. Daniel fostered Ipswich Suffolk.

Daniel was rescued from a sheepfold in Romania when he was a puppy. The shepherd called a known rescuer and said that he was going to “get rid”of all the dogs because there were too many.

When rescuers went for them they were all tied very tightly in a sealed cardboard box. One of the pups was even tied at the muzzle. They were seconds away from suffocation.

Daniel and two of his sisters were not lucky enough to get adopted as pups and so grew up in the private shelter. Safe and loved but in a pen not experiencing the joys of their own home. Daniel is now in a UK foster home awaiting an adoption offer.

Daniel is a happy and affectionate boy with a lot of love to give. He mixes well with other dogs but would also be happy as the only dog in his forever home, he’s also fine with cats. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Carl
description:
Carl is a medium sized crossbreed aged two to three years old. Carl fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Carl was taken into the Botosani public shelter as a pup, nobody remembers who took him there or why. Sadly he didn’t get picked for adoption so he grew up there.

The day that the puppies there get transferred from the puppy block to the adult block is a very depressing day indeed, their chances of ever leaving decrease significantly on that short walk across the shelter

Thankfully Carl is now in a UK foster home. He is a sweet boy who is initially wary of new people but does bond after just a few days. He gets on well with the other dogs in his foster home but could also adjust to being the only dog given time.

He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Carl has a deformity in one of his front legs. It’s possible that he’s had the defect from birth and it doesn’t hold him back or cause him discomfort.

name: Dwayne
description:
Dwayne is a large mountain shepherd mix aged around seven years old. Dwayne the rock fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Dwayne has come into our care recently as his owner was no longer able to meet his needs. He is a lovely boy who needs the company of another dog in his forever home.

He’s not selective on who that dog maybe as he appears to be pleasant and sociable with all of them!

Dwayne has the dopiest grin and is a sweet and affectionate boy. We would like a home with large breed experience for him who will not be put off by his booming big boy bark .

Dwayne hasn’t been around children so will need an adult home environment.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around eight to ten years old.Eric fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We originally met Eric a couple of years ago in the Botosani public shelter in Romania. After we left he was attacked at the throat by the other dogs in his pen so we asked for a space at Crivatu private shelter to move him to.

He has had a lovely time in the safety of that sanctuary for the past couple of years but it’s now his turn to get into a proper home for his twilight years.

Eric can be a quirky little chap until you get to know him but he is a dear little soul with a permanently smiling face that you cannot help but grow to love.

Eric is enjoying short walks but will need to lose some weight and build fitness gradually to enjoy a level of walking that should come more easily to him. He gets on well with other dogs and is very good with cats.

He needs an adult home environment. It’s taken a while for this little dude to come waddling to the UK and we’re hopeful that he will find his forever person or persons so that he can continue to enjoy the comforts of domestic life.

name: Pete
description:
Pete is a large crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Pete is fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pete and his siblings were found in a city in Romania in January 2025. Small pups, lost, wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Pete is a typical adolescent dog, clumsily learning the canine lessons of life. He is initially shy with new people and takes time to bond. He is not an overly affectionate dog but will always be close by.

Pete would love to live with another playful dog but could go as the only dog. Pete could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He will need an adopter experienced with large breeds who has the time and patience to win his trust.

name: Havannah
description:
Havannah is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Havannah fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Havannah came into our care recently as her owner could no longer look after her. After an initial few days of shyness she evolves into a sweet and loving girl who enjoys a fuss and will happily curl up with you on the sofa.

Havannah has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in her forever home . She walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family.

She can live with respectful children 12 plus.

name: Britney
description:
Britney is a medium, sized, lab-type crossbreed of around 3-4 years old.

Britney is fostered in Marlborough Wiltshire.

We met Britney and her mum and sister when we visited the Botosani public shelter in Romania at the beginning of October last year.

All three travelled to the UK to start a new life away from the horrors of the shelter, and both mum and sister are now happily living in their forever homes.

Britney is a friendly and affectionate girl who is submissive and hand-shy at first, but once she is settled she is extremely sweet and loves a fuss and a cuddle.

Britney will need a resident dog(s) in her new home. She would also be ok with confident cats and respectful children aged eight and over.

name: Princess
description:
Princess is a medium sized Chow cross aged around five years old. Princess fostered Hockley Essex.

Princess has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. Life wasn’t so very terrible for her in the first few months of her stay at Botosani.

Her and her brother were in a pen on their own and they had each other to snuggle up to and play with. A few weeks ago we were gutted to learn that her brother left the shelter and she remained behind.

We’ve been conspiring to get her from the very second we knew he left as we were eaten up by how miserable she would be and how she simply wouldn’t understand why he suddenly vanished.

Our hearts literally ached for her. We’ve had set backs along the way and it’s taken far longer than we wanted but, finally, she is in a UK foster home and she’s having a ball.

Princess is an incredibly friendly and cheerful girl who settled instantly in her foster home and quickly behaved like she’d never lived anywhere else!

She gets on well with her foster siblings but could also live happily as the only dog in her forever home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Hovis
description:
Hovis is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old.

We met Hovis on the last day of our trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania in March 2024. He so nearly missed being seen amongst the 800 prisoners there until at that eleventh hour his enquisitive and cheeky face appeared in the pen next door.

He was in with some very old and grumpy dogs and had been for some time. He finally boarded the van to the UK last September and has been awaiting his forever home.

Hovis is a sweet and affectionate boy who will play for hours with his canine friends in his foster home. He absolutely loves his walks but does pull a little on the lead so will need further training, he has a fabulous time when we take him to a secure field.

He loves to play with toys and would like another playful dog in his forever home if possible.

Hovis would like an adult home environment and is perfectly fine with cats.

name: Tara
description:
Tara is a small to medium sized female crossbred aged around twelve years old. Fostered in Rollesby Norfolk.

Tara originally came into our care several years ago. She was rehomed along with two other of our dogs but they have sadly all had to come back to us recently as their adopters unexpected health issues means she can no longer care for them.

Tara has lived with cats and dogs but could happily be the only dog in the home. She loves her walks and is in good health for her age. She will need an adult family and can be wary of some men.

name: Neddy
description:
Neddy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten months old. Neddy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Neddy was part of a litter that were found abandoned somewhere in Corbeanca, Romania, in a field. No mum with them. A lady contacted rescuers and begged for help… Bianca took them to her shelter.

The only girl left for Belgium, the daughter of the lady who found them adopted her. One boy left for Germany.

Dave arrived a couple of months ago and was successfully adopted and now Neddy has arrived along with the other two remaining siblings to find their happy ever afters.

Neddy is a very sweet and playful boy who is loving the adventure of the change to a UK foster home. He’s having great fun playing with other dogs and humans alike.

He’s having could live with other dogs or as an only dog. Loves his toys and fuss and walks nicely on a lead. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Ralph
description:
Ralph is a medium sized golden Labrador cross aged around eight years old. Ralph fostered Taverham Norfolk.

We believe this boy to be Rupert’s son and he’s an absolute chip off the old block with both looks and stubborn mannerisms.

Poor Ralph spent years in the Botosani public shelter in Romania, his two brothers are still there and can’t come to us until we’ve found homes for the two such similar souls that we have already!

Ralph is a sweet old soul that is learning all about his new domestic life, but he’s insistent on putting up a little bit of protest regarding “new tricks” such as walking on a lead.

He’ll do it, and he’ll enjoy the walk, but he’s just gotta tell you first that he doesn’t appreciate being restricted to going where the humans want him to go. If he wants to sniff something, he’s going to let you know, he’s just actually very amusing!

He asks for a fuss but then looks confused about why he’s asked and why he’s enjoying it, but you can see that he is . It’s a lot to get used to and he’s just through the process in his own unique way and we’re loving watching it happen.

Ralph gets on with other dogs to a point but would rather be the only dog in the home. Despite never having a bed or bedding in his life before, he’s decided he likes them and he doesn’t want to share them.

It’s all bluster and bravado but perhaps it would be easier just to let him have his own way in this one and let him be the only dog in the home, he does deserve to be spoilt after all! He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Despite all the comedy antics, Ralph is so happy to be here and be around the humans who he seems to understand are just trying to love him and be his friend. His tail is wagging a lot these days and he just needs his own forever home to wag it in!

name: Finn
description:
Finn is a five to six month old crossbreed pup who we believe will grow to be medium sized. Finn fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Finn has come into our care recently from the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. He is initially quite hand shy with new people but his confidence is growning daily.

He is much braver when he has an adult dog to shadow around and we would therefore need to find him a home with at least one other dog in permanent residence.

He is mixing well with the safe rescue cat and will need a home with children no younger than twelve.

He will need all the usual training and care that all pups need and adopters should expect peeing, poohing, chewing and potentially sleepless nights until work is put into training them out of it.

name: Romeo
description:
Romeo is a chunky medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Romeo fostered Norwich Norfolk.

He has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

We’ve known this boy for over two years now and walked him on several trips to the shelter. He’s always been so happy to see us and a really nice boy to take out. He’s very friendly and confident.

Romeo could live very happily with a female dog or dogs but would also enjoy being the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Peter
description:
Peter is a large crossbreed aged around fifteen months old. Peter fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Peter and his siblings were found in a city in Romania last January. Small pups, lost and wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Peter has been on our care since last July. For most of that time he was very neurotic and skittish but recently we’ve all noticed an element of him maturing and becoming a lot more confident.

He still spooks at some things but the spooky reaction is not so melodramatic and passes quickly.

Peter is a sweet boy once he knows you, he’s not ready for strangers being hands on with him but he gets used to new people so much faster now and we’re still working daily on improving his confidence.

Peter will still need an experienced adopter with the time and patience to continue with his confidence building. He will need a calm and steady household with no children.

He will need a confident dog in his forever home that will play with him as he loves the rough and tumble of his foster pack.

name: Hilda
description:
Hilda is a large Romanian shepherd cross. Her passport says she was born Feb 2019 but she acts a bit older than six.

We have been a part of Hilda’s life and her a part of ours for years. She was in the private shelter in Crivatu Romania the very first time we visited and stayed there until 2024.

The story of how she came to be rescued, if indeed it’s true, is too horrible to put into print so I will just say that she has been through a lot and, although understandably scared of people, treats us with nothing but gentleness.

Hilda is a large dog with a calm presence. She moves with grace and poise and is quite regal in her demeanour.

She will avoid strangers if she can but once she is used to the people in the home she will choose to be close by and always looks like she wants to come for a fuss but she’s just not quite ready yet.

When you go to her she is happy to be fussed and groomed and will fall asleep with her head on your lap.

Hilda is not keen on her walks and really doesn’t want to go for more than fifteen minutes. We are not sure if this is a crisis of confidence or if it’s a mobility issue, she’s a difficult dog to read.

She walks nicely on a lead but can panic when spooked so we are looking for a rural home for her as she will not cope with a lot of traffic or crowds.

Despite her fears Hilda is such a gentle dog, she will need a calm and quiet environment with no children under twelve and with at least one other dog.

Anyone considering adopting her must be calm and patient in gaining her trust and maybe she will never fully open up to humans due to the horrors of her past. She is fine with the safe rescue cat, but won’t look at him.

name: Sara
description:
Sara is a medium sized crossbreed born December 2021.

Sara has came into our care from Romania at a year old as her carer there was moving to the UK and she was worried for her future.

Sara is a placid and sensitive girl who can be a little cautious of new people. She quickly warms up to family though and is an affectionate and friendly girl.

Sara mixes well with other dogs but could also live as an only dog. She would need an adult family as she can be anxious around playful behaviour.

Sara needs a calm and quiet home environment as she can be very anxious around visitors to the home. She is such a loving and sweet girl to her family but has spent three years in our care now with no offers of a home.

name: Cessil
description:
Cessil is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Cessil fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Cessil has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter where he has been imprisoned for at least the last couple of years.

Cessil is an affectionate and fun dog once you get to know him but is initially hand shy with strangers. Cessil loves the company of other dogs and will need at least one other dog as permanent resident in his forever home.

Cessil has initially been quite resistant to lead training but is now getting the hang of it and will just need to build up confidence with practise in his forever home. He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Elena
description:
Elena is a five to six year old female Cross-Breed who is medium to large in size and currently fostered in Marlborough, Wiltshire.

She can live with or without other dogs, can live with children of all ages, and has not yet been cat tested, though she may be suitable.

We met Elena in March this year when we visited the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. She had a badly twisted front leg. She had two operations to try and fix the damaged limb, but sadly they didn’t work and it was ultimately amputated.

Elena is the most joyous dog you could ever meet. Despite her surroundings in the grim shelter she remains bubbly and upbeat.

She is friendly and affectionate and loves everyone she meets. Elena mixes well with other dogs but could also live happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children of all ages.

name: Whiskey
description:
Whiskey is a medium sized crossbreed aged three to four years old.

We met Whiskey about eighteen months ago when we found him in an emaciated state in the Botosani public shelter. We immediately moved him to a private shelter where he would be able to eat properly and gain weight.

Eventually we were able to take him in the UK

On arrival Whiskey was very distrustful of us, but he now loves us so much he can barely contain it all . Whiskey is very playful and will need another dog in his forever home as full time resident.

He’s still wary of strangers but when he loves you he is the most loyal and affectionate boy. Whiskey walks nicely on a lead but is still a bit wary of having the lead put on and taken off, we will continue to help him grow more confident with this whilst he’s in our care.

Whiskey will need someone experienced with nervous dogs as gaining his trust initially wil take time. Once the bond is made though he is truly a dog in a million.

name: Lizzie
description:
Lizzie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four to five years old.

Lizzie came into our care around a year ago after we met her on a trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She was scarily emaciated back then and we did wonder if she would survive long enough for us to get her to the UK. She did make it onto the bus and arrived safely in her uk foster home.

Lizzie was always curious about people and happy to be around them but was initially afraid to be actually touched but is now a very affectionate and loving girl with huge enthusiasm for human contact.

Lizzie enjoys the company of other dogs and would prefer another, full time resident, dog in her forever home. She would be ok as an only dog if someone was home most of the time and she had plenty of interaction with other dogs out on walks.

Lizzie is a playful and cheery girl who enjoys her walks. She can be wary of tall men in the home until she gets to know them well. Lizzie is fine with the safe rescue cat and can live with children aged twelve plus.

name: Percy
description:
Percy, affectionately known as Percy pig, is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Percy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Percy came into our care recently as his owner could no longer look after him. After an initial few days of shyness he evolves into a sweet and loving boy who will subtly ask for a fuss.

Percy has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in his forever home . He walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family. He would like an adult only home.

name: Enid
description:
Enid is a small to medium sized whippet like crossbreed, she is believed to be around three to four years old. Enid fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Enid came into our care a few weeks ago from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is initially a little shy but with love and kindness grows in confidence fairly quickly.

She mixes well with other dogs and would need another dog in her forever home. She would be ok to live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Rosco
description:
Rosco is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten months old. Rosco fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Rosco’s story told by his rescuer in Romania.

“Rosco was found in our community in the yard of some fools who keep their dogs unneutered. We rescued his mother (Roua), six of Rasco’s siblings, and Davina who had given birth a week earlier from that place.

It was -10 degrees outside, and they were lying on the ice. One puppy could not be saved because it had frozen to death.”

Rosco grew up in the safety of the private shelter after his rescue. We met him in June when we visited and he showed us what a loving and friendly boy he was growing up to be. He is now in a UK foster home looking for a forever family.

Rosco is a very friendly boy who loves human company. He would be fine to live with respectful children of any age. He mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in his forever home.

name: Kevin
description:
Kevin is a male medium sized crossbreed aged around nine months old. Kevin fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Kevin and his brother Kyron were rescued from a field in Romania in the dead of winter. They were there with their mother, Kara. Thankfully they were taken to a private shelter and kept safe until we could offer them a place here in the UK.

Kevin is a very kind and affectionate dog who loves people. He is still a pup and therefore will need guidance and training. He loves children and could live with respectful children of any age.

He mixes well with other dogs but could also live happily as the only dog in the home.

name: Pippa
description:
Pippa is a small to medium sized collie / spaniel type crossbreed. She is around three years old. Pippa fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pippa was found by the side of a road in Romania. She was all alone and covered in ticks. She was rescued and taken to a safe shelter and is now here in the UK looking for a new home.

Pippa is a very submissive girl and gives indication that she may have been beaten in her previous life. She is afraid of the safe rescue cat and won’t even look at him.

She mixes well with calm and placid dogs but would also love to be the only dog in the home. She would like a quiet and peaceful home where she can fully relax at last. She would like a home with no children.

name: Molly
description:
Molly is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around three years old. Molly fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Molly was rescued from a sheep field in Romania when she was a puppy. The shepherd called a known rescuer and said that he was going to “get rid”of all the dogs because there were too many.

When rescuers went for them they were all tied very tightly in a sealed cardboard box. One of the pups was even tied at the muzzle. They were seconds away from suffocation.

Molly and two of her sisters were not lucky enough to get adopted as pups and so grew up in the private shelter. Safe and loved but in a pen not experiencing the joys of their own home. Molly is now in a UK foster home waiting awaiting an adoption offer.

Molly is a happy and affectionate girl, she’s a little hesitant in new situations so will just need further socialisation.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home and will need another dog as full time resident in her forever home . She could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Sherman
description:
Sherman is a 10 month old pup who we think will grow to be medium sized but parentage is unknown.

We met Sherman in our last trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania. He is one of the less confident pups so we would need an adopter who has time and patience to settle him in his new environment.

He could live with or without resident dogs and would be suitable for children 12+.

He will need all the usual training and care that all pups need and adopters should expect peeing, poohing, chewing and potentially sleepless nights until work is put into training them out of it.

name: Matteo
description:
Matteo is a medium/large crossbreed aged around four years old.

Matteo has come into our care recently from Roxana’s shelter in Romania. He went into the shelter as a puppy along with his mum and sister and sadly grew up there.

Matteo is a comical character who is adapting well to his new life but still has a lot of new experiences to encounter. He has a whole catalog of facial expressions that make us smile.

He is not very brave when encountering new things but after a few repeats of them he loses his fears and is really starting to enjoy and be fascinated by life outside of the shelter.

He gets on well with other dogs and would like to live with at least one other dog in his forever home. He can live with respectful children aged ten plus.

He will need patience and guidance while he builds up confidence out in the big wide world. He is affectionate and cheeky with people he knows well and will make a fab addition to his lucky new family.

name: Bobbin
description:
Bobbin is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old.

Bobbin was a puppy in the Botosani public shelter in Romania and tragically he never got picked and therefore grew up there. The filthy concrete floors and metal bars are all he’s ever known until he recently traveled to his UK foster home.

Bobbin is having an absolute blast in his new surroundings. Following his foster mum around and learning new things by the minute. He is initially a little shy with strangers as he’s not seen much of people previously but it doesn’t take long at all to win his trust.

He is now living the puppyhood he was so tragically deprived of and playing all day long. His tail never stops wagging.

Bobbin mixes very well with dogs and needs a resident dog in his forever home. He wants to play with the cat and give him kisses, but soon submits when the cat puts him firmly in his place. Bobbin could live with respectful children aged 10 plus.

name: Cathy
description:
Cathy is a 9 month old pup who we think will grow to be medium sized but parentage is unknown.

Cathy has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is one of the less confident amongst the puppy craziness currently, but given just a little time and she is the sweetest and loving little girl.

Puppies need someone at home for a large part of the day. They can make noise, mess and chew up your stuff until they are trained not to do so and we really don’t like it when puppies get returned for simply being puppies so please consider this carefully before applying.

Needs a resident dog in her forever home.

name: Jack
description:
Jack is a 7-8 years old medium sized crossbreed.

Blue eyed Jack used to belong to a family who kept him in a 2×2 pen. Not on a chain but never walked, never socialized. Then at some point they got bored with him and wanted to get a terra nova or something similar to replace him with.

A neighbour took Jack, but could not keep him since she already had a lot of dogs. So he was moved to a private shelter where he stayed for close to two years and where we visited him on two previous trips. He’s an absolute sweetheart.

Jack is now looking for his forever home. Jack can be strong on lead as he loves his walks.

He gets on ok with other dogs but would prefer to live with a calmer female or as an only dog. Jack really likes children and could live with respectful children aged seven plus.

Jack enjoys structure and routine and would be particularly good at something like agility or hoopers.

Have you got a place in your heart for this blue eyed boy?

name: Ben
description:
Ben is a medium sized (overweight) male crossbreed aged around seven to eight years old. Ben is fostered in Mattishall Norfolk.

Ben was on a kill list at a public shelter in Romania when a lady in the UK offered to take him.

Unfortunately, Ben was unhandled and the lady was not prepared or experienced enough to cope with his rehabilitation and so we were asked to go and get him and enter upon that journey with him.

It’s taken several months but Ben is now ready to move on. He still has the annoying habit of chewing through his lead if not watched carefully hence the metal lead in the pics!

Other than that he’s actually emerging into a sweet old boy who has even begun to casually ask for fuss and attention.

His love for food helps to win his trust and confidence but at some time soon his diet and exercise regime are going to have to be addressed. This will be secondary to becoming friends though.

Ben mixes well with other dogs and would like at least one other dog in his forever home. He really can’t be bothered with the cat.

He will need someone patient to win his trust but after a few weeks he has the potential to be a comical and loving companion. At this point effort will need to be made to retrieve the waistline I’m sure he once had

If you like a dog with a bit of quirk and character and appreciate a little stubbornness chucked into the mix for good measure then Ben is the boy for you.

He won’t love you overnight but you’ll enjoy the challenge of getting to that point with him and treasure the bond even more. He will need an adult family with someone with a reasonable level of experience.

name: Harper
description:
Harper is a small to medium sized female crossbreed aged 18 month old.

Harper had a start in life that is sadly all too common in her native country of Romania. She was taken into the Botosani public shelter at a very young age as one of hundreds of puppies that get dumped there each year and she simply didn’t get picked for adoption.

So many waste what is supposed to be care free puppy time living in the stress and filth of the shelter. They grow up not knowing anything other than what is contained in the depravation of their pen.

Harper has recently arrived in her uk foster home. She has been for her first walk, set her feet on grass for the first time and is tip toeing her way through so many other new and daunting experiences for the very first time.

She’s bright and alert and picking everything up at a rapid pace and we desperately hope we can find her a family that will continue to show her both the simple pleasures in life and the love she has been missing since birth.

Harper mixes well with other dogs and will need another confidant companion dog in her forever home. She is already showing a fun and cheeky character and just needs to continue gaining experience and confidence. She could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Billy
description:
Billy is a smallish crossbreed aged around three years old. Billy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Billy was found outside the gates of the Crivatu private shelter in Romania around a year or so ago and pretty much invited himself inside. He has lived happily there until recently joining us in the UK to look for his forever home.

Billy is a cute little “man about town” kind of guy with a lot of character. Secretly he’s quite sensitive and insecure with new people and new situations but he “styles it out” with an air of nonchalance initially.

A couple of days later when he realises he’s in safe hands he is your best and most loyal friend. Billy loves a fuss and a cuddle, he’s enjoying his walks and loving being a domestic house dog.

Billy gets on well with other dogs and would like another dog companion in his forever home ideally but would settle as the only dog in the home with a little extra time too. He is living happily with a cat currently and would like an adult home environment.

name: Cristina
description:
Cristina is a medium to large sized crossbreed, she is around a year old.

Cristina was rescued as a pup from the streets of Crevedia in Romania. She came to the UK last September and was quickly adopted. She has recently been returned because she didn’t have a good relationship with the man in that household.

Cristina was cared for by a man in Romania and there is also a man in her current foster home, both of which she gets on well with.

Cristina lived with a cat and a small child in that home and loved playing with them but sometimes got “a bit much” as she’s still an overgrown puppy.

She is a sweet and loyal girl who needs a little further training on puppy behaviours. She is a leggy, clumsy, lovable fool who just needs a little time invested in her.

Cristina is loving playing with the other dogs in her foster home and would benefit from a young playful dog in the household but could live as an only dog if sufficiently exercised and stimulated.

She is a beautiful-natured little girl who loves people and has been socialised with children aged eight plus. Cristina mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home.

Cristina has begun to learn to walk on a lead but will need further practise. She will need all the usual socialisation and training that every pup should receive.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a small to medium-sized crossbreed of around 8 years old fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Maggie came to us from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She had been in there almost all her life and her existence in the dire place had left her shut down and afraid of humans.

It’s taken a long time but Maggie is now a cheeky and confident girl in her foster home. She is still afraid of people she doesn’t know but is comfortable being touched and groomed by those she knows. She is not yet asking for fuss and attention but this will come later in a more one-to-one environment.

Maggie has met cats and was fine with them.

Maggie needs a home experienced with nervous dogs. She is enjoying her walks now and would like quite an active exercise routine.

It is essential that Maggie lives with at least one other dog so please do not apply unless you have a dog full time in your home. Maggie could not cope with the noise and unpredictability of small children but would be ok with dog-savvy children of ten plus.

Maggie has recently started showing an interest in toys and enjoys chewing on a Nylabone, this has been so lovely to see. She is a massive lover of food and when the treats come out or dinner is being prepared she will push her way to the front and bark, demanding hers.

Maggie often goes to an enclosed field where she can run around off-lead. She used to spend her time at these by herself but now likes to stick with the group, only falling behind if she’s found something good to sniff.

Unfortunately, Maggie had a falling out with another resident dog in her adopted home and this has caused others to initiate bullying behaviour towards Maggie and she is regularly picked on, causing her a lot of stress on a daily basis. She needs somewhere with a nice doggy friend where she can gain confidence with her humans in her own time.

name: Barney
description:
Barney is a medium sized crossbreed currently aged 1 year old (born Jan 25)

Barney came into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. On arrival he was shut down and terrified of us and we did think we had a long road of rehabilitation ahead of us.

However the lure of the fun of the pack in his foster home was too strong to resist and within days he was running around, playing and getting into mischief like all pups should!

He’s pretty comfortable around people too now, with the help of food and treats, but he will need further convincing about fusses and cuddles because he isn’t really appreciating those just yet.

This little boy is so comical and fun and his facial expressions are highly entertaining. He will need at least one other playful dog in his forever home. He can live with respectful children aged twelve plus and wants to play with the cat.

name: Queenie
description:
Queenie is a medium sized collie cross aged around five to six years old.

I felt like Queenie was a hidden gem, lost in the crowds at the Botosani public shelter in Romania when we visited in October. I don’t even know if she was there on previous trips, if she was I didn’t see her.

As I was stood outside a pen I saw the flicker of a wag of a tail from inside one of the dog houses, and then her little nose poking out daring herself to come and make friends. I entered the pen and bobbed down to her level and after just a few seconds of talking softly to her she crept forward and put her head on my knee.

Queenie is a submissive girl that would like a quiet home environment. She can live with other dogs but likes dogs that give her a bit of space and don’t jump all over her or get in her face. She’d be very happy to be an only dog in the home. She would like an adult home environment with someone with collie experience.

name: Levi
description:
Levi is a male medium sized crossbreed aged around 18 months old. Levi came to us a from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. Having been discarded like rubbish as a baby, he spent his first weeks and months in the squalid conditions there with little to no human interaction.

When he arrived in the UK he was terrified of humans and it has taken several weeks to get him to the point that he’s ready to find his forever home.

Levi is fostered in North Walsham, Norfolk.

Levi is now a fun loving pup who enjoys being around people he knows well. He is cheeky and playful with us but still very tense and unsure of human touch, this will come with time.

Levi is recovering really well from an operation on his leg which he is expected to make a full recovery from. The vet believes trauma at a young age prevented the femoral head developing properly and was thus causing pain when moving against the hip socket.

Levi loves to play with the other dogs in his foster home and will need a reasonably playful companion in his new home. We would not consider a home for him that doesn’t already have a resident dog.

He’s learning really quickly how to walk on lead and responds well to direction even in these early days. This is definitely his most favourite time of day. He’s a pleasure to take out and it’s lovely to see him enjoying life to the full with his foster pack.

He will be very cautious when anyone comes to see him and so needs someone who can see beyond this to the dog he will one day become.

He is making such good progress, learning that human contact is actually a really good thing and something to be enjoyed. You can see him visibly relax once cuddles commence, asking for more when it stops.

He’s come such a long way in a short space of time and will continue to thrive with someone willing to give him time, love and sausages

Levi will need a home with no children under twelve.

name: Isadora
description:
Isadora is a two to three year old medium sized crossbreed.

Isadora was taken into the Botosani public shelter in Romania, along with an unremembered number of siblings, when she was just a baby. She is an example of why we work so hard to get all pups out while they are still pups.

She grew up there, spent her adolescence there, never seeing the outside of her concrete pen. She missed out on the silliness and care free attitude of youth because she was concentrating on staying alive.

When we met her at two years old she had learnt to be cautious of some people and she hadn’t experienced as much as the feeling of grass under her feet. She arrived here a few weeks ago and she had to learn it all from scratch.

As you can see from her pics, the girl has learnt well and she has learnt pretty fast! She is now a cheeky character who dares to push herself forward in the pack in her foster home.

She is the instigator of most of the games, she tries to take our cake when we have a coffee break (cardinal sin) and she is generally curious about everything.

Isadora loves to be around us, she will get so excited when anyone comes round and she will boop them with her nose, but she is still very tense when stroked and will try to change any attempts of love and affection into another game.

The loving bit will come with time and it’s something she can learn over the first weeks and months in her forever home. She will need a patient and understanding adopter with at least one other dog that will match her playfulness and energy.

She is gaining confidence on walks and we will, of course, continue her lead training while she’s with us. But she is ready to move on now and continue her development and growth in the environment she gets to spend the rest of her life in.

Isadora will need an experienced adopter who will understand all that she was deprived of in her early life. She will need patience and guidance but is already showing how great she will be once her last fears are overcome. She could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Albie
description:
Albie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around eight years old. Albie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Albie came into our care initially in 2021. He’d been previously abandoned in a field in Romania and was saved by rescuers there.

He was adopted quite quickly but has now been returned five years on because he’s not adjusted well to life with a new baby.

Albie is ok with other dogs but not hugely interactive with them and would be quite happy as an only dog. He has previously lived with cats.

Albie needs an adult family as can be jumpy with sudden movements. He enjoys his walks and absolutely loves to be groomed.

name: Carrie
description:
Carrie is a 9 month old pup who we think will grow to be medium sized but parentage is unknown. We met Carrie in our last trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania.

She is such a sweet girl and really looked for fuss when we entered the pen. Given the time and space, she will be such a loving girl.

Carrie would be happy with or without a resident dog and would be suitable with children 10+.

name: Lindsay
description:
Lindsay is a 1 year old pup who we think will grow to be medium sized but parentage is unknown.

Lindsay has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

She is a gentle girl who’s had a difficult start in life, but she’s shown such courage and strength along the way.

After recovering from a broken leg, she’s now doing really well and is expected to make a full recovery.

Though a little shy when meeting new people, Lindsay’s affectionate and playful side soon shines through once she feels safe.

She would be happiest as the only dog in her new home, but this isn’t essential and could live with children aged 12+.

Lindsay has been patiently waiting for her chance, and now she’s ready to find her forever home.

name: Solomon
description:
Solomon is a smallish whippet/sheltie type crossbreed aged around five years old.

Solomon was brought to the UK from Romania as a puppy by a private adopter who then couldn’t cope with him so we were asked to step in. He was rehabilitated and adopted back in 2020 but has recently been returned to our care due to a change in domestic circumstances.

Solomon is quite whippety/sheltie like in behaviour as well as looks. He is a bit of a worrier and tense around new people but very loving to his family. In a pack he is very playful but a little bossy with smaller dogs so would like a home with a dog either his own size or larger. He will need an adult only family. Solomon loves his walks and getting out and about but will need a confident and experienced adopter.

name: Trinity
description:
Trinity is a medium sized female cross breed aged around 2/3 years old. Trinity is fostered in Norwich Norfolk

I met Trinity during a trip to a Romanian shelter back in October last year. She was living outside on the street along with a few other dogs and was pregnant, not for the first time sadly.

When the rescuer captured her inside the gates of the shelter she asked if we would take her and of course we agreed.

Unfortunately the neighbourhood were not kind to the dogs in that street and would throw rocks at them to chase them away as they didn’t want them around.

As a result of this Trinity is extremely wary of men and will bark at them. In time she can learn to trust individual men but we sadly cannot erase these memories altogether.

Ideally an all female home would be best but a very patient and understanding man could win her trust over time.

It is only barking, it’s like she’s trying to warn the others that there’s a man around and they should be scared, the others ignore her and carry on with their day lol.

Trinity is currently living with many other dogs and for the most part is ok. She can be a little jealous over food and fuss though so maybe a home as the only dog would be easier.

She would need a home with no children under the age of twelve. Trinity walks nicely on a lead and is loving her new domestic life.

name: Jellybean
description:
Jellybean is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Jellybean fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Jellybean has spent all of her life in the Botosani public shelter until she came to the UK to a foster home a few weeks ago.

Due to the limitations of shelter life poor Jellybean has had to get used to pretty much everything. She has done so well in the short time she’s been here so we are confident that over the coming months she will continue to shine.

She is cautious of new people and a bit bemused about human affection generally as she’s never experienced it, but it’s dawning on her more and more that it’s a nice thing and not so worrying after all.

She will need another dog in her forever home to learn from and for reassurance as she encounters more new life experiences.

Jellybean is not bothered by the safe rescue cat. She will need a calm home environment with no children under the age of twelve. She walks beautifully on lead but is still a little wary of the big wide world.

name: Gertie
description:
Gertie is a large crossbreed aged around five years old. Gertie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Gertie came to the UK from a squalid shelter in Romania. She is a big girl but calm and placid around the home. Gertie gets on well with other dogs and ignores the safe rescue cat. She walks nicely on a lead.

She would prefer an adult family – but visiting children is fine. Large breed experience preferred.

name: Benji
description:
Benji is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around nine years old. Benji fostered Fakenham Norfolk.

Benji was originally adopted from us a few years ago and has been very well loved and cared for. Sadly he has recently had to be very reluctantly returned due to insurmountable personal reasons.

Benji is a very sweet natured and a quiet dog. he’s no trouble whatsoever. His owners will need to be with him most of the time, as he can be anxious when being left on his own for more than a couple of hours.

He can live with respectful children aged eight plus.

Benji gets on with most dogs out and about but there are a few he takes exception to. He has lived happily as the only dog. Benji loves people, he walks well on the lead enjoy his walks.

name: Matilda
description:
Matilda is a huge Romanian Shepherd aged around seven years old. Matilda fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We met Matilda on our trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania back in March. Generally we don’t willingly take Rommie shepherds as they are a specialist breed that require experienced adopters.

Because she was a middle aged dog we just couldn’t leave her there to live out her retirement years.

Matilda is now in the UK and looking for that experienced adopter. She is the most beautiful, calm, quiet of dogs who requires only gentle exercise and a garden to potter in.

However her genetic program to “protect her flock” is still lingering and she will bark protectively when strangers approach her family.

Of course barking is not going to physically hurt anyone, but she is a big dog with a big booming bark and that can of course be intimidating.

She needs a home where visitors are not a common occurrence and she needs to be put in her own safe space when they do come to prevent any situations where people feel threatened.

Matilda is the most loving and sweet girl with her family. Despite her size her movement is slow and seldom so it’s kind of like having a large rug that gets up and moves itself to another room sometimes.

She is fine with cats and dogs and is very steady around goats and horses….. again her descendency from protecting sheep in the mountains serves her well. Shes just an all round great dog who takes her family duties quite seriously. She will need an adult home environment.

name: Jenkins
description:
Jenkins is a medium sized crossbreed aged around three years old. Jenkins fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Jenkins has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

Jenkins is a quirky boy who forms strong bonds with his “person”. If he was a human I guess he would be classed as a little OCD which can lead to some peculiar behaviours.

He is somewhat oblivious to the concept of personal space and can be a trip hazard around the home due to always having to be “right there”.

He is currently living alongside other dogs in his foster home and will play happily with the pack.

As a creature of habit he can become unsettled when new dogs come into the home and over stimulated when things get chaotic and therefore a quiet and steady how with little coming and going would suits his needs best.

As time passes he is becoming more relaxed, he is an extremely loving and affectionate boy who would be great company for a single person or couple. He is ok with cats, could live with or without another dog but will need an adult home environment.

name: Lou
description:
Lou is a lovely crossbreed aged around 7 months old. We believe she will be medium to large sized when fully grown but parents are unknown. Lou fostered North Walsham, Norfolk.

Lou arrived at Roxanas shelter in Romania after being found alone in the city. She was just only few weeks old but was on her own on the streets.

Lou has been shown love at the shelter and now has the chance of a better future in a forever home of her own.

Lou is slightly reserved initially but asks for fuss once she knows you. Puppy training classes would be great to help with bonding and behaviour as she matures.

Lou will need someone to help her gain confidence on walks as this is a whole new world outside the shelter.

Lou gets on well with other dogs, she has lived with another puppy and socialised with young adult dogs. She likes to play but occasionally will take herself off for a little rest.

She would like another dog in the home but could be equally as happy as the only dog in the home so long as the adopter has a little experience and can keep her well socialised.

She would need to learn to be an only dog as she has never been on her own before. Lou could live with respectful children aged 8 plus.

name: Pixie
description:
Pixie is a pretty crossbreed aged around 6 months old. We believe she will be medium sized when fully grown but parents are unknown. Pixie fostered North Walsham, Norfolk.

Pixie arrived at Roxanas shelter in Romania after being found with her littermates in the woods. They were tied into a trash bag, at one day old.

The man who found them, asked us for help. They were bottle fed but sadly Pixie is the only survivor. She has been shown love at the shelter and now has the chance of a better future in a forever home of her own.

Pixie is a lively little girl and will need a fairly active home. Puppy training classes would be great to help with bonding and behaviour as she matures.

She is such a happy and affectionate dog and loves attention once she knows people. Pixie will need someone to help her gain confidence on walks as this is a whole new world outside the shelter.

Pixie gets on well with other dogs, she has lived with a bigger puppy and socialised with young adult dogs.

She would like another dog in the home but could be equally as happy as the only dog in the home so long as the adopter can keep her well socialised and spends a lot of time with their dog. She could live with respectful children aged 8 plus.

name: Floki
description:
I’m a 5 year old medium size cross breed boy.

For 3.5 years, I’ve been living in a shelter in Hungary, that’s more than half my life spent waiting behind a fence, hoping someone might stop… might notice me… might choose me. But no one ever has. Sometimes I feel invisible. I’m only 5 years old.

I’m not loud or demanding. I’m patient and quiet. I’m the kind of dog who waits in silence and hopes that one day someone will see the good boy I truly am and will not walk past me.

I love my walks, and I walk beautifully on the lead. I enjoy sniffing the world and feeling the sun on my back. I love hoomans—every scratch behind the ears and every cuddle means the world to me, because I get so little affection here.

But I treasure every moment. I never take kindness for granted.

I’m calm and peaceful around other dogs. I don’t want trouble; I just want love.

And although my muzzle is beginning to grey, please don’t think I’m old. I’m still young, playful in my soft and gentle way, and I dream—every single day—of having a home, a bed of my own, and a family who finally calls me theirs.

I have spent so long waiting, but I haven’t given up.I still believe my person is out there.

If you’re reading this… maybe it’s you.Maybe you’re the one who will make sure I’m invisible no more.

Floki is ready to travel from Hungary once the right family is found.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU passport.

name: Connie
description:
Connie is a 2 year old female Puli Cross. Her story began in a public pound, where she grew up in harsh conditions. A year ago, she was rescued in a heartbreaking state – skin and bone, frightened and frail.

With care, love, and patience, Connie has blossomed into a happy, affectionate girl. Today she’s full of life – her waggy tail never stops, she adores treats and cuddles, and she has even learned to smile when she’s with the people she loves. This beautiful girl has learned to trust again!

Connie loves the company of other dogs and is especially playful – wrestling and mingling are her favourite games! She would be just as happy snuggling up on the sofa as she is joining in on adventures.

Connie is still waiting in a small shelter in Hungary, dreaming of her forever family. She deserves a home where she will be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the sweet, resilient girl she is.

For Connie, an experienced rescue dog home would be ideal – someone patient and understanding, ready to continue guiding her on her journey.

She could live happily with another friendly and playful dog or as the only dog in the home.

2 years oldPlayful, affectionate, sociableSpayed, vaccinated, microchipped, with EU passportCan travel to the UK once her family is found

If you can give Connie the love-filled home she has been waiting for, please get in touch.

Adoption subject to home check & fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Gesztenye
description:
Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Topi
description:
Topi is a 10-month-old medium sized cross breed boy. He is a real bundle of joy, very people-centred, affectionate and kind natured. He loves cuddles, attention, and being involved in whatever his humans are doing.

Topi is lovely friendly pup who loves to run, explore and play. He learns quickly, especially when there are treats and praise involved. His eagerness to please makes him a lovely dog to train and grow with.

He would thrive with an active family who enjoys daily walks, adventures in nature or even hiking. Topi would happily join in on family outings and would love to be part of everyday life rather than left on the sidelines.

Topi is brilliant with other dogs, and enjoys playing with them. He is very sociable and makes friends easily.

He would probably be happiest living with another friendly, playful dog, but may as well enjoy being the only dog in the home, soaking up all the attention.

Because he is still young, Topi will need time and patience to settle into a new environment and learn the routines of his new home. With kindness and guidance, he will quickly blossom into a truly wonderful companion.

He could live with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to interact respectfully with a puppy. He can also be tested with cats for the right applicant.

Topi is currently in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU pet passport.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, expected to be medium-sized when fully grown.

She is currently in Hungary and is adorable and playful, as expected for her age.

Seven siblings were born in an abandoned property with their mum struggling to feed them when she was emaciated herself.

They were taken in by the local shelter at three weeks of age.

The whole litter was stunningly beautiful, and only two pups are still waiting for their families.

Maggie is fully vaccinated, free from parasites, and ready to travel. She comes with an EU passport.

She can live with dogs and older children. The right owner will need to agree to have her spayed once fully grown.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is a 1.5 year old male Cross-Breed, medium in size. He was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with his sister, Suzy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Tommy and Suzy can be rehomed together or separately.

Tommy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy dog who is active and playful according to his age. He is medium-sized and has a lovely happy character. He is very affectionate with people and friendly around kids, too.

Tommy is the more human-centred of the siblings. He loves giving kisses and is a lapdog by nature.

He is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Tommy would be happiest in a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for his training. We want him to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. He will need time to settle into his new home and get used to his environment.

Tommy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy as the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tommy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Damian
description:
Introducing Damian, a nearly two-year-old male Cross-Breed who weighs 11.4 kg and is ready to steal your heart. Playful, affectionate and full of energy, this boy has a bright, joyful personality and is sure to bring happiness into any home.

Damian adores his toys just as much as he enjoys the company of other dogs. He absolutely loves all the attention and affection he gets from people.

He can be rehomed with female dogs. He can live with a resident dog or as an only dog.

Still young and eager to learn, Damian is ready to find his forever home, a place where he can thrive and share his cheerful spirit every single day. A home where he will be loved and cared for the way he deserves to be.

Could you be the one to make Damian’s dream come true?

Foster with a view to adopt is also an option.

Damian is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in the UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Sadie
description:
Sadie is a five-year-old female Lurcher who sadly found herself in rescue and, after a month with us for assessment, is now looking for a new home.

Sadie was initially picked up as a stray and was adopted into a home in 2022, where she remained until a change in circumstances meant she found herself back in rescue and due to be put to sleep.

Due to this, despite initially seeming friendly and confident, she will need time to settle into a new home and build trust in her new owners.

Sadie can experience some separation anxiety, which causes her to be destructive at times. She also needs some TLC to continue gaining the weight and muscle she has lost due to stress.

Sadie has proven to be good with other dogs but cannot be rehomed with cats. Sadie would enjoy a quieter life, preferably as an only dog, although this is not a deal breaker.

Sadie has proven to be social and friendly towards everyone she meets. She has enjoyed a pub visit, lots of countryside walks, a good bed and plenty of snacks.

Sadie is crate trained, house trained and well mannered on and off lead. She loves to play fetch, chew on a good bone and is incredibly affectionate, always by your side.

Sadie would make a lovely addition to any home and, of course, as with all my dogs, she will have RBU for life and behavioural support.

She is spayed, microchipped and crate and house trained.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.
