A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Chill
description:
Chill is a 1-year-old smaller medium-sized Puli girl with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul.

This beautiful girl was found abandoned alongside another Puli cross and taken to a kill shelter, where her future looked uncertain. Thankfully, she was given a second chance and came into our care.

When Chill first arrived, she was timid and reserved, unsure of the world around her. But once she settled into boarding and realised she was safe, her true personality slowly began to shine.

Today, her tail is up, she greets us with a smile, and every day she grows a little braver.

True to her name, Chill is exactly that – calm, quiet, easy-going and wonderfully relaxed. She is relaxed around other dogs, too and mingles beautifully with them, although she can feel overwhelmed by noisy or boisterous dogs.

She walks nicely on the lead and has a peaceful, gentle nature.

After being abandoned once, we would love her next chapter to be the one she truly deserves — a home where she will never be left behind again, where she is included in everyday life and can become a treasured member of the family.

Currently in Hungary and ready to travel to the UK once the right family is found.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Lana
description:
Lana is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl from Hungary who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown.

Lana has already had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated. Despite everything they have been through, Lana has chosen love over fear.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She has a slightly calmer nature than her sister, but still enjoys playing, exploring and having fun.

She is a sweet affectionate puppy who could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and can live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lana has never known what it’s like to belong to a family of her own, but she’s ready to learn. She dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and people to love for the rest of her life.

Lana is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown. Lucy’s had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated.

Her past could have made her fearful, but luckily it didn’t, and Lucy is full of trust and love.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She is a true puppy, full of life, loves to play and explore. She is jolly happy girl with a fun character.

Lucy is a sweet affectionate puppy, she loves dogs and could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and could live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lucy dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and a family to love for the rest of her life.

Lucy is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: GeeGee
description:
GeeGee is a tiny 18 month old female Chihuahua × Miniature Pinscher weighing just 4kg.

She is currently located in foster care in [FK5 3HZ], Scotland.

GeeGee is the perfect combination of an affectionate lap dog and an active little companion.

She loves curling up on your lap for cuddles but equally enjoys walks, playtime and exploring.

Friendly, cheerful and full of character, she will bring endless joy to her forever family.

name: Missy
description:
Our extra special girl Missy is around two years old and rather small but a staggeringly attractive cross breed. Missy weighs just seven kilos and measures seven inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned in a very remote area by a member of the public, Missy has been in our Cyprus shelter for a short time.

Our shelter manager describes Missy as the sweetest dog in the shelter. She is calm, affable and very loving. Missy adores attention and makes close eye contact.

A truly empathetic little girl. Her happiest moments are on a lap or having a cuddle. She is so happy on a one-to-one basis.

Missy’s appearance is exceptional. She is a joyous little bundle with puppy dog eyes, a soft cream coat with light tan ears and a near-perpetual smile. Missy awaits her very fortunate adopting family.

name: Heidi
description:
Our extra special girl Heidi is approximately five years old and a rather small cross breed. Heidi weighs just five kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw.

Very sadly one of her devoted owners passed recently leaving the other unable to cope with a dog as he is a wheelchair user. Heidi arrived in our Cyprus shelter very recently.

Heidi has a delightful personality and a zest for life. She cherishes every moment when she’s out of her pen and socialising with her human companions. Heidi adores a cuddle, a walk and a lap. She is smiley, inquisitive and lively.

Heidi has attracted a substantial fan club from the shelter staff, volunteers and all the visitors go to her first. Her appearance is sublime with a soft brown coat with a white flash to her chest and four tips.

Puppy dog eyes, elevated ears when she’s excited and a bushy tail make Heidi a shining star. Such a perfect little adoption candidate.

Heidi walks nicely on her and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with children and other dogs however Heidi is not cat tolerant. She cannot be homed with felines.

name: Donny
description:
Donny – Shih Tzu puppy boy being fostered in adult home in Gloucestershire with other dogs will be ready at 8 weeks old.

Donny was born with his sister & brother in our care after Bella his mum came to us three weeks before they arrived, giving her time to settle into her foster home and get to know her foster mum.

All three puppies are thriving. Our vet has already checked them and will continue to monitor them as they grow, with no health concerns noted so far. He is a lovely happy little puppy who will be well balanced and cared for before he leaves our care.

We know these puppies are going to be very popular because, let’s face it, they are ridiculously cute! We will no doubt receive lots of offers of homes, but finding the right homes for puppies is actually much harder.

We are looking for people who have always believed in rescue rather than buying from a breeder and who understand that a puppy is so much more than a cute little teddy bear.

Some people who have always wanted to rescue may actually feel a little guilty about applying for a puppy — please don’t!

We would much rather see a lovely rescue-minded family offer a home to one of these babies than someone who simply wants a puppy because they are cute or because buying one from rescue is cheaper than going to a breeder.

These little ones need homes prepared to put the work in — puppy classes, socialisation, training, plenty of stimulation and proper walks, not just a quick stroll around the park.

They are bright, active, happy little dogs who will grow into real characters and need to be allowed to live a proper dog’s life.

They will have the very best start with us and will be well socialised with people and other dogs. Now comes the important part — finding the right people to continue that work and give them a wonderful life as part of their family.

We will not home puppies with entire dogs. Where there are adult dogs in the home, we will need to be confident that they will be safe around a puppy and will provide a good role model.

As part of their adoption contract, all three puppies will be neutered when old enough. They will also be health checked, microchipped, flea and worm treated and started on their vaccinations before they leave us.

So, we are just putting out the feelers for now. We will update their profiles every week as their characters develop and we get to know what sort of homes will suit each puppy best.

We have put a huge amount of care into giving these little ones the best possible start.

Now starts the hard job of matching them with sensible, committed homes who understand dogs and will carry that work on — giving them the proper dog’s life they deserve.

name: Kira
description:
This is Kira — a beautiful girl with a glossy, shiny coat. She was found as a stray in Cyprus and has been at a shelter ever since.

Kira is a large female dog who is a confident girl. Kira is super friendly and loving with people she knows and strangers alike. She gets on well with children but we would recommend any children in the home to be aged 10+ due to her size.

Kira enjoys the company of male dogs of a similar size to her. She can be picky with female dogs, but only if they are reactive with her. We also don’t recommend that she is homed with small dogs due to her size.

She is a beautifully well rounded girl who is quite easy going and just happy to be in your company. She takes treats calmly and gently and we suspect she will be a joy to train once you have formed a bond with her. Kira already walks well on the leash.

Kira is healthy, ready, and waiting for someone who sees the incredible companion she can be. She thrives with leadership and will reward the right person or family with loyalty, protection, and deep affection.

Kira will need an experienced handler who understands strong breeds and can continue guiding her with structure, consistency, and love.

Kira is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and has been tested for infectious diseases. She is fully vaccinated and spayed.

name: Rose
description:
The sweetest Rose, nearly 4 years old, neutered, medium-sized, German short haired pointer.

Sweet Rose has been in our Cyprus shelter since September 2025, quietly waiting for someone to see her.

She’s the kind of dog people walk past without realising how much she’s hurting — gentle, sensitive, and trying her best to cope in a place that overwhelms her.

Rose can be frightened at times, and the truth is, shelter life will never help her grow in the way she needs. The noise, the chaos, the constant movement… it’s simply too much for a soft soul like hers.

What she needs is a calm, patient home where she can finally exhale and learn that the world isn’t scary.

She isn’t a difficult dog — she’s a worried one. And worried dogs blossom beautifully when given love, kindness, and time. And, knowing what pointers are like, she is desperate to show some affection to humans that she can trust.

Rose would thrive in a quiet home with people who understand that progress comes in gentle steps. Someone who will celebrate the small wins, offer reassurance when she’s unsure, and show her what safety feels like.

Once she trusts you, her sweetness shines through. She is frightened of children so she can only be homed with a family if children are over the age of 15 yrs old.

This girl has waited long enough. She deserves that certain someone/couple or a family who will help her feel safe, wanted, and cherished.

Rose is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and has been tested for infectious diseases. She is fully vaccinated and spayed.

name: Donald
description:
DONALD — EVERYTHING A FAMILY DOG SHOULD BE!

Donald is a three year old male cross breed.

Donald is the dog people describe when they tell us what they are dreaming of. A gentle dog. A calm dog. A dog who loves people, understands other animals and can be trusted around children.

A dog who walks into a room and brings peace with him. Donald is all of that. He is three years old, middle-sized, and has the most beautiful nature we could ever wish for in a dog.

He adores people. He is wonderfully gentle with children, fantastic with other dogs and friendly with cats.

But those words still do not explain what it feels like to be around him.

Being with Donald feels like being close to something completely good. He looks at you with that radiant smile, comes near with such softness and settles beside you as though being together is the most natural thing in the world.

Loving Donald happens before you even realise it. We can see him beside a child, quietly watching over them. We can see him sharing his home with another dog and becoming their closest friend. We can see him carefully greeting the family cat.

We can see his smiling face waiting at the door, his head resting in someone’s lap and his beautiful presence becoming part of every ordinary day. And that is what breaks our hearts.

Because Donald should already have this life. He should already have someone who knows the sound of his paws walking through their home.

Someone who kisses his head before bed. Someone who looks at that beautiful smile every morning and knows they chose one of the finest dogs they could ever have found.

Donald is one of our rescue’s favourite dogs. We know him. We know the goodness he carries. We know how easy he is to be around and how deeply he deserves to be loved.

He asks for so little from the world, yet he brings kindness into every place he enters. All we want now is for Donald to find a home where that kindness will finally come back to him.

A home that will love him with the same gentleness he gives to everyone else. A family who will understand that they have not adopted just a wonderful dog. They have been given a gift.

3 years oldMiddle-sized boyCalm, loving, gentle and deeply kindWonderful and gentle with childrenFantastic with other dogsCat-friendlyAdores peopleRadiant, smiling and beautifully easy to share life withOne of our rescue’s most loved dogs

DONALD’S HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis testedMicrochippedFull RBU

Please message us if Donald feels like the calm, loving boy your home has been waiting for! He really is a one-of-a-kind boy!

name: Willow
description:
WILLOW — A LITTLE DOG WITH EVERYTHING YOU COULD EVER WISH FOR!

Willow is a two-year-old female cross breed.

Some dogs are easy to love from the very first moment.

At only two years old, this beautiful middle-to-smaller girl has the kind of character people spend years hoping to find.

She is loving.Kind.Gentle.Clever.Eager to please.

But more than anything, Willow is simply a joy to be around.

She gets along beautifully with other dogs, loves people and is wonderful with children. She has such an easy, lovely way about her — friendly without being overwhelming, affectionate without demanding, happy just to be included and close to those she loves.

Willow is smart and willing to learn. She listens, she connects and she wants to make you happy.

She is the kind of little dog who would bring warmth into a home without ever asking for much in return.

A walk beside you.A soft place to sleep.A family to call her own.

And Willow would give back everything she has — her trust, her loyalty, her happiness and her whole gentle heart.

Willow does not need to become the perfect family dog.

She is simply waiting for the family who will finally see that she belongs with them.

WILLOW — AT A GLANCE:2 years oldMiddle-to-smaller-sized girlLoving, kind, gentle and affectionateSmart and eager to pleaseWonderful with other dogsGreat with childrenLoves people and family lifeA joyful, easy and truly special little dog

WILLOW IS IN PERFECT HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis tested

Please message us if you believe Willow could be the little girl your home has been waiting for.

name: Ted
description:
Meet Ted – A Little Frenchie Who’s Finally Ready to Be Loved

He came into our care as a UK rescue after being pulled from a local pound by one of our trusted pound pullers.

Before that, Ted had been seized by the Metropolitan Police as part of a cruelty case, and when he arrived with us, it was clear he’d endured a great deal of neglect. His little body was covered in fleas and he was suffering from a severe flea allergy.

His skin was red, sore and painfully itchy, and he’d lost much of the fur across his back and around his face. It must have been incredibly uncomfortable, but despite everything he’d been through, Ted’s gentle nature still shone through.

Fast forward to today, and this handsome little man is a completely different dog.

Ted has now been fully assessed by our vet, has been castrated, is responding brilliantly to treatment, and his beautiful coat is growing back nicely. Best of all, his happy, affectionate personality is beginning to shine brighter every day.

What Ted is Like • Exceptionally affectionate and loving

Loves nothing more than cuddles and human company

Loves being close to his favourite person Ted has formed an incredibly strong bond with our General Manager and absolutely adores her.

He thrives on companionship and is happiest when he’s close to the person he loves. He can sometimes bark when meeting strangers, but this isn’t aggression—it’s simply his way of letting everyone know they’re there.

Once he realises everything is okay, his lovely personality quickly takes over.

Ted’s Ideal Home Although Ted gets along well with other dogs, we feel he’d truly flourish as an only dog where he doesn’t have to share his favourite person’s attention.

His perfect home would ideally be with a single person, preferably a lady, who is looking for a devoted little companion.

Someone who is home for much of the day would suit Ted perfectly, as he simply loves being part of everyday life and doesn’t ask for much more than a comfy bed, gentle walks and plenty of cuddles.

A calm home where he can continue to feel safe, secure and cherished would be everything this little boy has ever dreamed of.

Why We Love Ted Ted is proof that kindness can change a life.

Despite the neglect he suffered, he hasn’t lost his trust in people.

Instead, he greets each day with a wagging tail, a hopeful heart and an endless supply of love to give.

He isn’t looking for a life of excitement or adventure. He’s looking for his person. Someone who will adore him just as much as he’ll adore them.

After everything this little boy has endured, we so desperately want to find him the forever home he has always deserved. Could that be with you?

Could You Give Ted His Happy Ending? If you think you could offer Ted the safe, loving home he’s been waiting for, please visit: www.savingandrehomingstrays.org

Potential adopters must be willing to travel to Ayr to meet and collect Ted. Let’s make sure the rest of Ted’s story is filled with nothing but love, comfort and happiness.

name: Laura
description:
Our extra special girl Laura is approximately three years old and the most stunning medium sized cross breed. Laura weighs just twelve kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Laura has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Laura can be best described as incredibly close to canine perfection.

Her smile is perpetual, her eyes are bright and engaging, her ears are prize winning, her teeth are shining white, and her glorious tri-colour coat is enhanced by an array of freckles and a pigmented tummy.

She adores her play time with her friends and engages beautifully with her bubbly sweet personality. If ever there was a prime adoption candidate designed to make a family unbelievably happy it’s Laura.

She walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. Laura seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Daisy
description:
DAISY — SHE NEEDS A HOME TO SHOW WHO SHE REALLY IS!

Daisy is a three year old cross breed female.

Daisy is always smiling. Even in kennels, even while keeping herself just a little apart, that beautiful smile is there. She is three years old, small, gentle and full of the sweetest little character.

She loves other dogs, enjoys being around people and carries a quiet happiness that never seems to leave her face. But we do not believe kennels show us the whole Daisy. She is not scared. She is not timid.

She simply keeps a little distance around people, as though she is waiting for life to become softer before she gives us everything that is inside her. And we truly believe that life will begin in a home. Away from kennel noise.

Away from constant movement. Inside a peaceful space where she can learn the rhythm of her people, find her favourite bed and finally understand that she belongs there.

That is where Daisy will bloom. We can already see glimpses of the girl waiting underneath.

A loving little soul. A smiling companion. An adorable character who wants to be close, but needs the right surroundings to fully relax and shine. Daisy is wonderful with other dogs, and a calm, friendly dog may help her settle beautifully into family life.

She is never pushy or demanding. She simply needs a home where closeness can grow naturally.

Kennels are keeping Daisy waiting between two lives. She has left the kill shelter behind, but she has not yet reached the life she was saved for. She should be waking up in a warm home.

She should be walking beside her people. She should be carrying that lovely smile from room to room, slowly becoming more affectionate, more confident and more herself with every passing day.

Daisy does not need fixing. She needs the chance to live. And we believe that once she steps out of kennels and into the right home, this beautiful little girl will finally show everyone just how much love, happiness and personality she has been carrying all along.

DAISY — AT A GLANCE:3 years oldSmall mixed-breed girlWonderful with other dogsLoving, gentle and always smilingAdorable, never pushy and full of quiet characterNeeds a calm home where she can relax and truly bloomCould happily live with a friendly canine companion

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis testedMicrochippedFull RBU

Please message our adoption page if you can give Daisy the home life she needs to become everything we know she can be. Daisy is already smiling. Now she needs a home that will give her every reason to shine!

name: Captain
description:
Captain is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed.

Captain came into our care from another rescue and since being with us has ensured every day is full of fun and excitement.

He is obsessed with food and isn’t guilty of stealing your lunch.

Very bouncy and full of joy Captain will require a home with older teenagers due to his long legs and is happy as the only animal.

Sadly, he is avoidant of other dogs and prefers human companionship.

His prey drive is very high, and he is potentially Bull lurcher in breed, so he is walked on lead with a muzzle and enjoys off lead exercise within a secure field.

name: Kylo
description:
Kylo is a 4 year old, medium sized, lab-cross and is literally the friendliest boy. He simply adores being around humans and will be the best companion.

Oh and he knows some tricks! When he arrived at the shelter he was microchipped so he had some sort of home at some point in his life.

He craves love and attention from everyone he meets, even if just meeting for the first time. He’s very smart and will be a joy to train.

Kylo is a very sweet boy and has a puppy-like energy where he is just happy and excited to be with you and show off his tricks. And he’s very food oriented!

Some dogs in the shelter he accepts, others he doesn’t. Although this can be a product of the stress of shelter life, it’s best if he is an only dog.

Kylo can be quite energetic and will likely need an active home. He would even make a good running buddy. He already walks well on the leash.

Kylo can be adopted in the UK or Cyprus. His adoption fees are sponsored so, if travelling to the UK, we are just asking for travel costs to be covered.

He is ready to fly. He is vaccinated, castrated, and has had a full health check and blood tests for infectious diseases.

Full rescue back-up is provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue, a UK-based registered charity.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Hannah
description:
Our extra special girl Hannah is approximately three years old and a cross breed at the very bottom end of medium with a strong beagle appearance.

Hannah weighs a perfect eleven kilos and measures thirteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Hannah has been in our Cyprus shelter for three weeks.

Having clearly been preloved, Hannah is finding shelter life not to her liking. She is longing for her forever home away from the noise and bustle.

Hannah leans towards being timid but will thrive and blossom with her very fortunate adopting family. She yearns for peace and routine and will repay love and kindness with huge premiums.

Hannah’s appearance is exceptional in every aspect. Her tricolour coat is just glorious with some freckles and the loveliest ears ending in a point. Her kind, empathetic and loving nature abounds. Hannah is a truly wonderful adoption candidate.

She enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. Hannah seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Iris
description:
Iris is 9 weeks old female Presa Canario and ready for her new home.

Iris and her brothers and sister were born here at Ravenswood, so have had the best start possible.

They have been well socialised , handled and have been wormed regulary.

Iris is a happy, confident puppy, she will need a home with large breed experience. She will need to be well socialised and needs a home that are willing to continue her training throught her life.

Presa’s are big strong dogs, and need homes that are happy to take that on.

Iris will have her first vaccination, and be chipped prior to leaving. She will have to be neutered when old enough and we will require proof this has been done.

If you think you can offer Iris her forever home please get in touch.

name: Lyric
description:
Lyric is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Lyric fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We discovered this absolute beauty queen in the Botosani public shelter when we visited in March. It’s taken a few weeks for her turn to come to arrive in the UK, she’s here now and ready for a new life.

Lyric is a sweet and gentle girl with a cheeky side that’s just beginning to emerge.

Once settled she does tend to love her human a little too much and can become possessive/protective over them if allowed to and will therefore need an adopter who is experienced with shepherd types or similar natured dogs.

Lyric is living very happily with multiple other dogs in her foster home but could become bossy if allowed to “rule the roost”.

She can live with dog savvy, confident cats but would be likely to chase more timid or skittish cats. She needs an adult home environment and would be best suited to a single person or couple.

name: Raggie
description:
Raggie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten years old. Raggie fostered Norwich.

Raggie was rescued from a kill shelter in Romania when he was a youngster and has lived in a private shelter since then.

Despite having a nice place to stay all these years it was not a proper home and we really want his retirement to be something more comfortable.

Raggie is a sweet and inquisitive boy who enjoys the company of other dogs and is absolutely fine with the safe rescue cat. He would like a quietish home environment with at least one other calm dog in residence.

He is not really used to a lot of human contact but is adapting well to human interaction and beginning to really seek it out. He has surpassed all expectations as we expected him to be much more independent.

He’s just a dear old chap that doesn’t really ask much out of life at all.

name: Malia
description:
Malia is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Malia fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Malia and her mother were rescued from a crowded shelter in Romania. Her mother came to the UK before her and has since been rehomed.

Malia was very shy and distrustful on arrival due to lack of social interaction in her early life. She has since gotten used to her foster carers and is gentle and attentive with them though still a little hand shy.

She will continue to grow in confidence in the coming weeks and months with kindness and patience.

Malia mixes well with other dogs and will need another steady dog in full time residence in her forever home. She walks nicely on a lead but needs more practise and experience as she’s still playing a little catch up.

She doesn’t like cats and would like a home with no children under the age of twelve.

name: Toffee
description:
Toffee is a medium sized crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Toffee fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Toffee came into our care a few months ago from another rescue who we regularly work with. Sadly they had no foster place for him and he was not progressing in a kennel environment.

He arrived, like many have before him, scared of humans because his last experiences with them hadn’t been good ones. It took many weeks to get him to walk on a lead and even longer to accept human touch.

Finally we feel he is ready to find his forever home.

He is now a fun loving and cheeky chap who enjoys the company of the humans he’s learnt to trust. He will need an experienced adopter who will be willing to follow advice and wait patiently for that trust to extend to them too.

Believe me he is worth the wait! He is playful and friendly with other dogs and will need at least one full time canine companion in his forever home.

He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

If your dog pulls on the lead, then we can advise you on training methods that avoid harm.

name: Fry
description:
Fry is a small crossbreed aged around five years old.

Fry initially came into our care several months ago from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He was a submissive little chap who had quite a hard time in there.

He was quite quickly adopted and for a while things went well. Unfortunately as he found his feet he became possessive over beds etc and has recently been returned for this behaviour.

Since his return Fry has been learning that possessive behaviour isn’t accepted here and with firm rules and boundaries and confident handling the issue is manageable.

He will however need an experienced adopter who will not be phased by “stroppy terrier” behaviour.

Fry gets on well with other dogs but would be quite happy as the only dog in the home. He wouldn’t want to live with any dog that was too boisterous or in his face.

He ignores the safe rescue cat and will need an adult home environment. Fry enjoys his walks and is good on and off lead. He is an affectionate little boy who enjoys cuddles and fuss.

name: Boris
description:
Boris is a large crossbreed aged around ten to eleven years old. Boris fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Boris has come into our care recently after spending many years in a private shelter in Romania. This big bear of a dog has spent much of his life confined in a pen. To watch him experience the new freedoms of a foster home is really very special.

Boris is a dear old chap who loves every body he meets. He is getting on well with the other dogs in his foster home but would be very happy to live as the only dog in the home. He will need a cat free home but loves children of all ages.

name: Conga
description:
Conga is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Conga fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Previously to arriving in the UK recently, Conga has spent the whole of his life in the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

Astonishingly he has retained a happy disposition and love of humans despite the awful conditions there.

Conga is a loyal and loving boy who will follow you to the ends of the earth once you show him kindness. He will need some basic training to stop him jumping up to gain attention which we have started here.

He gets on well with other dogs and would benefit from another dog in his forever home but we don’t feel it’s essential. He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Lilly
description:
Lilly is a medium sized collie cross aged around six years old. She originally came from Botosani Public shelter in Romania – and has surprisingly been with us in foster for over a year now, patiently waiting her turn. Lilly fostered Milton Keynes.

She is a very calm, obedient and quiet girl who doesn’t ask for much. Doesn’t even jump on the furniture!

Loves to run and play with the resident dogs and would love to have a dog companion in her forever home.

She’s still a bit shy around new people but her confidence is growing each day.

What Lilly likes:country walks;rolling on the grass;treats in a kong toy;gentle strokes;calm environment.

What Lilly doesn’t like:traffic;loud or sudden noise;

Lilly pays no attention to the cats in her foster home. Whenever they approach she shows no interest.
